1.title: Yini Lisheya?
1.content: Cabanga kutsi wena nebangani bakho labangu-9 nonkhe nifaka {c}10 kute nitsenge emacicitho e-{c}100 ndzawonye. Ngamunye wenu ungumnikati we-1/10 walawo macicitho, futsi loko empeleni kulisheya! Nawutsenga lisheya ku-{retail}, ungumnikati wencenye lencane yato tonkhe titolo, yawo onkhe umkhicito, nayo yonkhe imali ({cName}) labayentako. Nayikhula kakhulu inkampani, incenye yakho iba nelinani lelikhulu! 🔥

quiz.q: Wena nebangani bakho labane nihlukanisa ngekulingana tindleko tesihlalo semageyimu se-{c}500. Ngamunye wenu ungumnikati wani?
quiz.explanation: Kuba nelisheya kusho kuba ngumnikati wencenye yalo lonkhe lutfo. Bantfu labasihlanu labakhokha ngekulingana basho tincenye letisihlanu letilinganako, futsi incenye ngayinye inemalungelo lafanako nalawo letinye.
options: Ngamunye une-1/5 (20%) wesihlalo
Lutfo, muntfu munye kuphela longaba ngumnikati waso
Sihlalo sonkhe ndzawonye, ngaphandle kwencenye yamuntfu ngamunye

2.title: I-{ex} Ichazwa
2.content: Cabanga nge-{ex} ({exFull}) njengemakethe lenkhulu ye-inthanethi, kodvwa esikhundleni sekutsenga emacicitho nome emafoni, bantfu batsenga futsi batsengise tincenye letincane (emasheya) tetinkampani letinjenge-{top5}. Ivulekile onkhe emalanga emsebenti ngaphandle kwemaholide emphakatsi, futsi tintengo tiyashintja lilanga lonkhe kuye ngekutsi ngubani lotsengako nangubani lotsengisako. I-{ex} {exDesc}! 🌍

quiz.q: I-{ex} ifana kakhulu nani?
quiz.explanation: Imakethe yemasheya ihlanganisa bantfu labafuna kutsenga emasheya nalabafuna kuwatsengisa. Ayiwanikati emasheya, ayikhetsi intengo, futsi ngeke ikukhokhele inzalo ngekushiya imali lapho.
options: Imakethe, lapho banikati bemasheya bahlangana khona nebatsengi
I-akhawunti yekonga, lapho imali ihlala khona itfole inzalo
Sitolo lesinikati emasheya futsi lesikutsengisela wona

3.title: Tinkunzi neTibhere
3.content:
Etimakethe, tilwane tiphetse 😄

🐂 Inkunzi = tintengo tiYAKHUPHUKA. Cabanga inkunzi igijima iya etulu ngetimphondvo tayo. Wonkhe muntfu uyawina, bantfu bayatsenga, kumnandzi.

🐻 Libhere = tintengo tiYEHLA. Cabanga libhere lishaya liya phansi ngesandla salo. Bantfu besabile, bayatsengisa, akusiso sikhatsi lesihle.

Nangabe lotsite atsi 'Ngi-bullish nge-{tech}', ucabanga kutsi intengo itawukhuphuka. Nangabe atsi 'bearish', ucabanga kutsi iya phansi. Utawuva lamagama yonkhe indzawo etimalini!

quiz.q: Umngani wakho utsi 'Ngi-bearish nge-{telco} lelisonto.' Loko kusho kutsini?
quiz.explanation: Bearish kusho kulindzela kutsi intengo itawehla, bullish kusho kulindzela kutsi itawukhuphuka. Libhere lishaya liye phansi, inkunzi iphosa iye etulu.
options: Ucabanga kutsi intengo ye-{telco} itawukhuphuka
Ucabanga kutsi intengo ye-{telco} itawehla
Ufuna kutsenga i-{telco} leningi ngangekwenteka

4.title: Yini i-Broker?
4.content:
Ungeke uvele uhambe uye ku-{retail} utsi 'ngicela unginike incenye yenkampani yakho' 😂 Udzinga i-broker: i-app nome lusito loluhlanganisa batsengi nebatsengisi emakethe yemasheya.

Cabanga nge-broker njenge-{shop}. Ufuna lutfo, i-{shop} ikuhlanganisa nalo. Iphatsa kuhweba futsi ikhokhise inkhokhelo lencane. Ema-broker latiwako eveni lakho ({name}) afaka i-{broker} nalamanye.

Nakhu i-broker LENGAKWENTI kona: kukhetsa kutsi ngumaphi emasheya latawukhuphuka. Idlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe. Intengo iyanyakata ngenca yaloko bonkhe bantfu labaphandle bakutsengako nabakutsengisako, hhayi ngobe i-broker yakho itsite kanjalo.

Noko ema-broker ayashicilela imibono. Bahlatiyi bawo balinganisa emasheya ngekutsi 'tsenga', 'bamba' nome 'tsengisa'. Umbono akusilo i-oda 🤷 Bahlatiyi abavumelani obala ngelisheya linye lelifanako, futsi labanyenti babo bagcina sebangalungi. Fundza kulinganisa njengekubuyeketa, hhayi njengemtsetfo.

I-NoobTrader ikufundzisa ncamashi kutsi loku kusebenta njani, mahhala, ngemali lelingisiwe!

quiz.q: Kungani udzinga i-broker kute utsenge emasheya?
quiz.explanation: I-broker yindlela yakho yekungena emakethe yemasheya, hhayi umbiki welikusasa futsi hhayi lobeka intengo. Idlulisela i-oda, futsi intengo ngiyo yonkhe lena imakethe lesele ivuma kuhweba ngayo. Bahlatiyi bayo bashicilela kulinganisa, kodvwa kulinganisa kungumbono, hhayi umyalo.
options: Ikhetsa emasheya latawukhuphuka
Ibeka intengo loyikhokhela lisheya ngalinye
Idlulisela i-oda lakho emakethe yemasheya

5.title: Tisekelo Tentengo Yelisheya
5.content:
Wake wabona kutsi emacicitho lambalwa lakhishwe kanye anyuka kanjani ngentengo nangabe aphuma? Kwenteka lokufanako nangemasheya. Konkhe kumayelana nekunikela nesidzingo.

📈 Bantfu labanyenti BAFUNA kutsenga → intengo iYAKHUPHUKA
📉 Bantfu labanyenti BAFUNA kutsengisa → intengo iYEHLA

Nangabe i-{telco} imemetela kutsi itfola emakhasimende lamasha langu-10 million, wonkhe muntfu ufuna incenye, ngako intengo iyandiza. Nangabe ibika kulahlekelwa lokukhulu, bantfu batsengisa ngekwesaba futsi intengo iyehla. Tindzaba, imiphumela, ngisho netintfo letisematfrendini kutinkundla tekuchumana tingasheshe tinyakatise tintengo temasheya!

quiz.q: I-{retail} imemetela inzuzo lengakaze ibonwe futsi ihlela kuvula titolo letinsha letingu-50. Kungenteka yini entengweni yemasheya ayo?
quiz.explanation: Inzuzo lelindzelekile lencono ivame kusho batsengi labanyenti, futsi batsengi labanyenti bacindzetela intengo iye etulu. Kusebentisa imali kute ukhule akufani nekuyimosha.
options: Iyakhuphuka njengobe bantfu labanyenti bafuna kutsenga
Ihlala injalo ncamashi
Iwa kakhulu ngobe isebentisa imali etitolo

6.title: Kufundza Lishadi Lentengo
6.content:
Lishadi lentengo lifana nevidiyo yetikhatsi letibalulekile temlandvo welisheya. Luhlobo loludvume kakhulu lishadi lemakhandlela. 'Likhandlela' ngalinye likukhombisa tintfo letine telilanga linye:

🟢 Likhandlela leliluhlata = intengo iKHUPHUKILE ngalelo langa (ivuleke iphansi, yavala isetulu)
🔴 Likhandlela lelibovu = intengo iYEHLILE (ivuleke isetulu, yavala iphansi)
📏 Imigca lemincane etulu/ngaphansi = intengo lephakeme kakhulu nalephansi kakhulu yelilanga

Nawubona emakhandlela laluhlata lamanyenti alandzelana, loko kukhuphuka lokunemandla. Lamanyenti labovu asho kwehla. Kufundza kufundza emashadi kufana nekufundza libhodi lemaphuzu emdlalo! 🎮

quiz.q: Ubona emakhandlela labovu lasihlanu alandzelana elishadini. Loku kukutjelani?
quiz.explanation: Likhandlela lelibovu livala ngaphansi kwalapho belivulele khona, ngako lasihlanu alandzelana atisikhatsi letisihlanu tekwehla. Umbala ukutjela kutsi iya kuphi, hhayi bukhulu bekunyakata.
options: Lisheya belikhuphuka emalanga lasihlanu
Lisheya belehla emalanga lasihlanu
Intengo yelisheya ayizange ishintje

7.title: Livolumu Nekutsi Ikutjelani
7.content:
Livolumu = mangakhi emasheya latsengiwe futsi atsengiswa ngelilanga. Cabanga ngayo njengekubukwa kwevidiyo ye-TikTok.

🔊 Livolumu LELIPHEZULU = bantfu labanyenti bayahweba. Nangabe intengo inyakata nelivolumu lelisetulu, luphawu loluchinile nalolwetsembekako, njengevidiyo lesakateka ngempela, hhayi ngemabhothi.

🔇 Livolumu LELIPHANSI = bantfu lababalwa kuphela labahwebako. Tintengo tinganyakata ngendlela lengakajwayeleki nalivolumu liphansi, njengevidiyo lenekubukwa lokutsatfu kuphela leyabelwana ngephutsa.

Hlola njalo livolumu nawubona intengo inyakata kakhulu. Ikutjela kutsi kunyakata kungekwempela nome ngumsindvo nje!

quiz.q: Lisheya le-{telco} legxuma ngi-5% lamuhla, kodvwa livolumu liphansi kakhulu. Kufanele ucabangeni?
quiz.explanation: Livolumu likhombisa kutsi bantfu bakholelwa kangakanani ekunyakateni. Kugxuma lokukhulu ngekuhweba lokuncane kakhulu kungahlehliswa kalula njengobe kwenteka, ngako hlola livolumu ngembi kwekukholwa kuphumela phandle.
options: Kusengito kakhulu ngempela, tsenga nyalo!
Livolumu leliphansi lisho njalo kutsi intengo itawuchubeka ikhuphuka
Kunyakata kungase kungetsembeki, livolumu leliphansi liyakwenta kusolise

8.title: Lisekelo Nekuphikisa
8.content:
Cabanga kutsi intengo yelisheya libhola leligxumako:

🧱 LISEKELO (support) = liphansi lapho libhola ligxuma khona. Intengo ichubeka yehla kodvwa ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi ifika kulelizinga, igxumela etulu futsi. Batsengi labanyenti bavela lapha.

🪟 KUPHIKISA (resistance) = siphahla lapho libhola lishaya khona. Ngaso sonkhe sikhatsi intengo ikhuphukela kulelizinga, icindzetelwa iye phansi futsi. Batsengisi labanyenti batsatsa imali yabo lapha.

Tihwebi tisebentisa lamazinga njengemephu yemdlalo: tsenga eceleni kwaphansi, tsengisa eceleni kwesiphahla. Nangabe ekugcineni intengo yephula kuphikisa, ivame kudubula iye etulu ngekushesha. Nangabe yephula lisekelo, tilungiselele kwehla! 💥

Secwayiso lesinye lesicotfo: lamazinga advwetjwa bantfu lababuka emashadi, akusiyo imitsetfo imakethe lekufanele iyilalele. Lisheya lingephula 'lisekelo' ngco futsi lichubeke. 📉

quiz.q: Lisheya ligxume ku-{c}50 katsatfu ngaphandle kwekwehla ngaphansi kwayo. I-{c}50 ibitwa ngekutsini?
quiz.explanation: Liphansi lelichubeka lihlonishwa lisekelo; siphahla lesichubeka siyala intengo kuphikisa. Kute kwako lokusetsembiso, kodvwa kokubili kufanele kwatiwe ngembi kwekutsi utsenge.
options: Lizinga lelisekelo
Lizinga lekuphikisa
Intengo yesiphahla

9.title: Kusabalalisa
9.content:
Cabanga kutsi usebentisa YONKHE idatha yakho ku-app yinye yekusakata. Bese leyo app iyawa. Usala ungenalutfo. 😩

Kodvwa nawusabalalisa idatha yakho ku-WhatsApp, ku-YouTube, NAKU-app yakho yekusakata, kuwa kweyinye akukubhidzisi konkhe.

Kunjalo nangekutjala imali! Nawufaka YONKHE imali yakho kulisheya linye bese liyawa, ulahlekelwa ngiko konkhe. Kodvwa nawuyisabalalisa ku-{telco} (tekuchumana), ku-{retail} (kutsengisa), ku-{tech} (tebuchwepheshe), nakuyi-ETF, kuwa kwalinye akuyibulali yonkhe iphothifoliyo yakho. Lelicebo lekusabalalisa libitwa ngekutsi KUSABALALISA (diversification). 💼

quiz.q: Une-{c}500 yekutjala. Nguyiphi kuleti lesabalalisa ngempela ingoti yakho?
quiz.explanation: Titolo tetimphahla letisihlanu tonkhe tikhuphuka futsi tehla ngenca yentfo yinye, ngako imali lesabalaliswe kuto icishe ingasabalaliswanga nhlobo. Timboni letehlukene tihlangabetana netinkinga ngetikhatsi letehlukene, futsi yiloko lokuvimba umphumela lomubi munye kutsi utsatse konkhe.
options: {c}100 ngayinye etitolweni tetimphahla letisihlanu letehlukene
{c}100 ngayinye etimbonini letisihlanu letehlukene
Yonkhe i-{c}500 enkampanini yinye loyitsandza kakhulu

10.title: Ingoti Nemvuzo
10.content:
Wake watsenga libhokisi lemfihlo? Ungatfola lutfo lolumangalisako, nome tibi nje. Leyo yingoti lephakeme / umvuzo lophakeme.

Kutjala imali kusebenta ngendlela lefanako:

✅ INGOTI LEPHANSI, UMVUZO LOPHANSI: Njenge-{retail}. Inkampani lenkhulu kakhulu, lesimeme kahle. Imali yakho ivame kukhula kancane futsi ngekuchubeka. Naka kutsi 'lephansi', hhayi 'kute'. Netinkampani letinkhulu tiyawa.

🎲 INGOTI LEPHAKEME, UMVUZO LOPHAKEME: Njengenkampani lencane lesacala yekumba. Ingakhula ka-10x, nome inyamalale. Njengelibhokisi lemfihlo.

Ngembi kwekutsi utjale kunoma yini, buta njalo: 'Yini lembi kakhulu lengenteka?' Nangabe ungeke ukhone kulahlekelwa yiyo, ungayitsatsi leyo ngoti!

quiz.q: Imali yedijithali lengatiwa ngumuntfu yetsembisa imbuyiselo ye-500%. Setsembiso lesikhulu kangako sikutjelani ngempela?
quiz.explanation: Ingoti nemvuzo kungemaphetselo lamabili enduku yinye. Kute muntfu lonikela nge-500% mahhala, ngako bukhulu besetsembiso empeleni bukala kutsi lonkhe linani lingashabalala kalula kangakanani. Ngembi kwekutsi ufake imali kunoma yini, buta kutsi simo lesibi kakhulu sibukeka njani nekutsi ungaphila naso yini.
options: Kutsengiselana lokuhle lokwedlulwe ngandlela tsite yimakethe yonkhe
Nakukhulu setsembiso, bantfu labasemva kwaso batimisele kakhulu
Litfuba lekulahlekelwa ngiko konkhe likhulu njengesetsembiso

11.title: Sikhatsi Lesidze vs Lesifishane
11.content:
🏃 KUHWEBA KWESIKHATSI LESIFISHANE: Kutsenga nekutsengisa ngekhatsi kwemalanga nome emasonto kute ubambe kunyakata kwentengo lokusheshako. Kucindzeteleka lokukhulu, kudzinga sikhatsi lesinyenti esikrinini. Kufana nekuzama kubikezela kutsi ngubani lotawuwina umdlalo ngamunye emcudzelwaneni.

🧘 KUTJALA KWESIKHATSI LESIDZE: Kutsenga emasheya futsi uwabambe iminyaka. Uyakhutsatela kwehla futsi uyekele imali yakho ikhule. Kufana nekubheja ngekutsi ngusiphi sicembu lesitawuwina sonkhe sizini. Awetfuki ngemuva kwemdlalo munye lomubi.

Tifundvo te-akhawunti tangempela tema-broker tichubeka titfola sifanekiso lesifanako: nabahweba kakhulu bantfu, bavame kwenta kabi ngemuva kwekubala tindleko.

Futsi sikhatsi yinzuzo yinye lengeke itsengwe futsi ngemuva. Wonkhe umnyaka imali lehlala itjaliwe ngulomunye umnyaka inzalo lehlanganisiwe isebenta. ⏳

quiz.q: Bantfu lababili batsenga emasheya lafanako ngemali lefanako. Munye uyangena aphume onkhe emasonto, lomunye uyawayekela iminyaka lelishumi. Tifundvo te-akhawunti tangempela tichubeka titfolani?
quiz.explanation: Kuhweba ngakunye kunetindleko, futsi leto tindleko tiyaphuma nome kuhweba kusebentile nome cha. Sifundvo ngemuva kwesifundvo se-akhawunti tangempela tema-broker titfola sifanekiso lesifanako: nabahweba kakhulu bantfu, basala emuva kakhulu. Kuyekela imali kungakuvilapha, kulicebo leshibhile.
options: Lomatasatasa uvame kusala emuva ngemuva kwekubala tindleko
Lomatasatasa uvame kuwina, ngobe umzamo uyavuzwa lapha
Bacedza balingana, ngobe babambe emasheya lafanako ncamashi

quiz.q: Ufaka 200 NT nangabe lisheya libita 100 NT. Lisheya bese liyawa, futsi i-200 NT yakho lelandzelako ifakwa nga-25 NT. Dvonsa uye etindlekweni takho temlinganiso ngelisheya ngalinye kulokukhokha lokubili.

quiz.explanation: Idividendi yincenye yenzuzo yenkampani lenikwa bantfu labangibanikati bayo. Le-app iyibita ngekutsi ema-Money Babies. 14.title: Inzalo Lehlanganisiwe

• Umnyaka 2: {c}1,100 → {c}1,210 (utfole {c}110, lokunyenti kunemnyaka 1!)
• Umnyaka 3: {c}1,210 → {c}1,331 (utfole {c}121)

Utawukubona loku kubitwa ngekutsi 'simangaliso sesishiyagalombili semhlaba' futsi kutsiwa kwashiwo ngu-Einstein. Abukho bufakazi bangempela bekutsi wake wakusho, kodvwa tibalo ticheme lesibalulekile, futsi tibalo tingetangempela. Cala ngekushesha, futsi sikhatsi sikwentela umsebenti lomatima.

quiz.q: Ufaka 2,000 NT nge-10% ngemnyaka futsi awuyitsintsi. Dvonsa uye kulinani layo ngemuva kweminyaka lemitsatfu.
quiz.explanation: Umnyaka wekucala wengeta 200 NT, lokwenta 2,200. Umnyaka wesibili utsatsa 10% wa-2,200, ngako wengeta 220 futsi wenta 2,420. Umnyaka wesitsatfu wengeta 242 futsi ufika ku-2,662. Njalo ngemnyaka i-10% ibalwa enkhumbeni lenkhulu, yingako kwengeta 200 katsatfu bese uma ku-2,600 kuphelelwa.

Cishe tincenye letisihlanu kulokusitfupha talenkhumbi kukhula: imali longakayisebentela, longakayonga nome longakayifaka.

Etikhatsini letidze, emadividendi latjalwe kabusha enta incenye lenkhulu yembuyiselo yonkhe yebatjali. Yingako ncamashi labo labakhokha emadividendi 'labadzinako' bagcina bangadzinanga nhlobo 💰

quiz.q: Utfola {c}80 ngemadividendi futsi usebentisa lonkhe lisenti layo kutsenga emasheya lamanyenti esikhundleni sekuyisebentisa. Kwentekani enkhokhelweni lelandzelako?
quiz.explanation: Lonkhe lisheya lelengetiwe lolitsengile likhokha idividendi yalo ngalokulandzelako, ngako inkhokhelo iyakhula ngaphandle kwekutsi wengete imali lensha. Loko futsi yinzalo lehlanganisiwe, kulokhu isebenta ngemholo kunekutsi ngentengo.
options: Inkhokhelo ihlala inebukhulu lobufanako, ifika nje ngemuva
Utfola lokuncane ngalokulandzelako, ngobe ubuyisele imali
Unemasheya lamanyenti, ngako inkhokhelo lelandzelako inkhulu

16.title: Umtsetfo wa-72
16.desc: Indlela lesheshako yekulinganisela sikhatsi sekuphindza kabili
16.content:
Nali likhodi lekukopela lebucopho bakho 🧠

Ufuna kwati kutsi kutsatsa sikhatsi lesingakanani kuPHINDZA KABILI imali yakho? Vele uhlukanise 72 ngembuyiselo yakho yemnyaka:

• 72 ÷ 12% wembuyiselo = iminyaka le-6 kute iphindze kabili
• 72 ÷ 8% wembuyiselo = iminyaka le-9 kute iphindze kabili
• 72 ÷ 6% wembuyiselo = iminyaka le-12 kute iphindze kabili

Ngako nawutfola 12% lochubekako ngemnyaka ku-{c}2,000, eminyakeni le-6 une-{c}4,000. Linda lenye iminyaka le-6 futsi une-{c}8,000. Lenye le-6 futsi une-{c}16,000! 🤯

Kulinganisela, hhayi umtsetfo, futsi imbuyiselo yangempela ayikaze ibe yinombolo lechubekako njalo ngemnyaka. Kodvwa isedvute ngalokwanele kutsi uyente engcondvweni yakho, futsi yiloko lokusemcoka.

Yingako kucala uneminyaka lenge-13 nome le-14 KUKHULU KAKHULU. Unetikhatsi tekuphindza kabili letinyenti embikwakho kunawo wonkhe lomunye umuntfu!

quiz.q: Kutjala kutfola 9% ngemnyaka. Sebentisa Umtsetfo wa-72 kute udvonse uye enanini leminyaka lekutsatsako kute kuphindze kabili.
quiz.explanation: Hlukanisa 72 ngemaphesenti emnyaka. 72 kuhlukaniswe nga-9 kungu-8, ngako imali icishe iphindze kabili eminyakeni lesiphohlongo, bese iphindza kabili futsi eminyakeni lesiphohlongo ngemuva kwaloko. Kulinganisela lokusheshako longakwenta engcondvweni yakho, hhayi umtsetfo lonembile, ngobe imbuyiselo yangempela ayikaze ibe yinombolo lefanako njalo ngemnyaka.

17.title: Ema-oda Emakethe vs Emkhawulo
17.content:
Kunetindlela letimbili letisemcoka tekutsenga lisheya:

⚡ I-ODA LEMAKETHE (market order): 'Tsenga nyalo nyalo nobe ngabe intengo iyini.' Njengekufaka enkalisheni bese uyakhokha masinyane ku-{shop}. Uyalitfola masinyane, kodvwa intengo loyikhokhako ngempela ngiyo nobe nguyiphi imakethe lekunika yona, lengehluka kunenombolo lobewisandza kuyibona esikrinini.

🎯 I-ODA LELINEMKHAWULO (limit order): 'Tsenga kuphela nangabe intengo yehlela ku-{c}X.' Njengekufaka intfo eluhlwini lwakho lwetifiso ku-{shop} bese ulindzela intsengiselo. Ulawula intengo, kodvwa kuhweba kungase kungenteki nhlobo.

Ema-oda lanemkhawulo akunika kulawula intengo. Ema-oda emakethe akunika sicinisekiso sekutsi liyagcwaliseka. Ungeke ube nako kokubili! 💸

I-oda lelinemkhawulo lisebenta ngendlela lefanako nawuTSENGISA, nje likhombe ngalokunye. Unalo lisheya, ubita intengo lobungajabula kutsengisa ngayo, futsi nangabe ikhuphuka ifike lapho i-app ikutsengisela. Nawutsenga, ubita intengo LENGAPHANSI kwalapho ikhona nyalo. Nawutsengisa, ubita intengo LESETULU. Umcabango lofanako, luhlangotsi loluphambene. 🔁

quiz.q: I-{tech} ihweba nge-{c}200. Ungajabula kuba nayo, kodvwa kuphela nge-{c}180 nome ngaphansi. Usebentisa liphi?
quiz.explanation: I-oda lemakethe ligcwaliseka masinyane ngayo nobe nguyiphi intengo lekhona ngaleso sikhatsi. I-oda lelinemkhawulo libita intengo yakho bese liyalindza, ngako i-app iyabuka esikhundleni sakho. Nangabe intengo loyivumako ibaluleke kakhulu kunekungena ngekushesha, lelo ngilo lolifunako.
options: Kutsenga kwemakethe, lokugcwaliseka nge-{c}200 nyalo
Kutsenga lokunemkhawulo lokubekwe ku-{c}180, lokulindzako
Buka sikrini bese utsenga ngesandla nge-{c}180

19.title: Ema-oda e-Stop-Loss
19.content:
I-stop-loss ifana nekubeka umkhawulo wekutsi ungavuma kulahlekelwa kangakanani: inetha yekuphepha loyibeka kusenesikhatsi.

Sibonelo: Utsenga emasheya e-{telco} nge-{c}100 ngalinye. Uncuma kutsi AWUFUNI nanini kulahlekelwa ngetulu kwa-15%. Ngako ubeka i-stop-loss ku-{c}85.

Nangabe i-{telco} yehlela ku-{c}85 → i-oda lekutsengisa liyacala ngalokutentakalela. Akudzingeki ube ubukile, futsi akudzingeki wente sincumo ngesikhatsi wesabile.

Nasi sicheme bantfu labasenta kabi. Inombolo ye-stop-loss NJALO ihlala ngaphansi kwentengo yalamuhla. Kufanele kube njalo, ngobe intengo kufanele yehle kute iyifinyelele. Yibeke ngetulu kwentengo yalamuhla futsi isivele iliciniso, ngako itsengisa ngesikhatsi uyibeka, ngentengo yalamuhla. Loko kutsengisa, hhayi inetha yekuphepha.

Ungakuphambanisi nekutsengisa lokunemkhawulo. Kokubili kutsengisa ngalokutentakalela ngentengo loyikhetsile. Umehluko yindlela: i-stop-loss iyacala nangabe intengo YEHLELA enombolweni yakho, kutsengisa lokunemkhawulo kuyacala nangabe iKHUPHUKELA enombolweni yakho. Kutivikela → inombolo yakho iya ngaphansi. Kubita intengo yakho → inombolo yakho iya ngetulu. Buta kutsi wenta yiphi ngembi kwekutsi ubhale. 🧭

⚠️ Lokukhulu: i-stop-loss icala KUTSENGISA, ayiyicinisekisi INTENGO. Nangabe tindzaba letimbi tifika ebusuku bese lisheya livula nge-{c}70 ngaphandle kwekutsi likhe lahweba nge-{c}85, i-oda lakho ligcwaliseka nganoma yini imakethe lengayikhokha ngempela. Loko kungaba ngaphansi kakhulu kwelizinga lolibekile.

Ngaphandle kwe-stop-loss nhlobo, ungabambelela unetsemba lekutsi liyabuyela... bese ulibuka lehlela ku-{c}20. 😬

Licebo lengcweti: Njalo ncuma kulahlekelwa kwakho lokuphakeme NGEMBI kwekutsi utsenge. Ungavumeli imiva yente leso sincumo nangabe intengo isayehla! 🧘

quiz.q: Utsenga nga-200 NT futsi uncuma kutsi awuvumi kulahlekelwa ngetulu kwa-15% kuko. Dvonsa uye entengweni lapho i-stop-loss yakho kufanele ibe khona.
quiz.explanation: I-15% ya-200 NT ingu-30 NT, ngako kuphuma kwakho kuhlala ku-30 ngaphansi kwalapho utsenge khona, ku-170 NT. I-stop-loss iya ngaphansi kwentengo yalamuhla, ngobe intengo kufanele yehle kute iyifinyelele. Yibeke ngetulu futsi isivele iliciniso, ngako itsengisa ngesikhatsi uyibeka, futsi loko kutsengisa kunekutsi kube yinetha yekuphepha.

20.title: Nini Kutsenga Nekutsengisa
20.content:
Liphutsa lelikhulu kakhulu labatjali labasha labalentako? Kutsenga nangabe wonkhe muntfu ajabule ngalokwecile nekutsengisa nangabe wonkhe muntfu etfukile. Loko ngempela kuphambene nalokusebentako. 🤦

📱 Nangabe ligrupho lakho lekuchumana lithumela kakhulu 'TSENGA LELISHEYA NYALO!!!!' → lomdlandla uvame kuba sewufakiwe entengweni. Sewephuzile.

😱 Nangabe wonkhe muntfu atsengisa ngekwetfuka → ngaletinye tikhatsi lelo litfuba lekutsenga ngesaphulelo. Ngaletinye tikhatsi intengo ichubeka yehla lomunye umnyaka. Kute muntfu lokhalisa insimbi ekugcineni kwaphansi.

Imfihlo? Yiba nelicebo NGEMBI kwekutsi utjale:
• Kungani ngitsenga loku? (lucwaningo, hhayi umdlandla)
• Ngitawutsengisa ngaliphi intengo nangabe iKHUPHUKA? (take profit)
• Ngitawutsengisa ngaliphi intengo nangabe YEHLA? (stop-loss)

Namatsela elicebweni lakho. Ungavumeli imiva yakho iphatse licebo lakho! 💪

quiz.q: Lonkhe ligrupho lakho lekuchumana lidvumisa lisheya leselikhuphuke nga-80% kulenyanga. Yini lokuhlakaniphile kukwenta?
quiz.explanation: Ngesikhatsi lisheya selikulo lonkhe ligrupho lekuchumana, kunyakata lokunyenti sekwentekile, futsi bantfu labafika sebephuzile batsenga kubantfu labatsatsa inzuzo yabo. Buka inkampani wena ngekwakho. Sicumbi lesisindvo lesikhulu asifani nesicumbi lesilungile.
options: Tsenga nyalo, ngembi kwekutsi intengo ikubalekele
Tsengisa lamanye emasheya akho bese ufaka konkhe lapha
Hlola inkampani wena ngekwakho ngembi kwekutsi uncume

21.title: Yini i-Market Cap?
21.content:
I-market cap (linani lemakethe) ikutjela kutsi inkampani inkhulu kangakanani ngempela, ngemali yelive lakho ({cPlural}).

📐 Ifomula: Intengo Yelisheya × Linani Leliphelele Lemasheya = I-Market Cap

Sibonelo: Nangabe i-{retail} inemasheya langu-1 billion futsi lisheya ngalinye libita {c}50, i-market cap ingu-{c}50 BILLION. Leyo 'yintengo' yayo yonkhe inkampani.

🔵 I-large cap: emagama lamakhulu kakhulu nalasimeme kakhulu, njenge-{tech} ne-{bank}. Ingoti lephansi, kuvame kukhula kancane.
🟡 I-mid cap: tinkampani letinebukhulu lobumaphakatsi. Ingoti lelinganako.
🔴 I-small cap: tinkampani letincane kakhulu. Tingakhula ngekushesha NOME tiwe kakhulu.

⚠️ Imikhawulo ayifani yonkhe indzawo. E-US, 'i-large cap' ivame kusho ngetulu kwa-$10 billion, kodvwa yonkhe imakethe ibeka emazinga ayo, ngako i-large cap eveni lakho ({name}) ayinabo bukhulu lobufanako ne-large cap e-US. Fundza inombolo yangempela, hhayi libhaji nje 🧐

quiz.q: Inkampani A inemasheya langu-5 million nge-{c}200 ngalinye. Emasheya eNkampani B abita {c}10. Dvonsa uye kulinani lemasheya (nga-million) i-B lefanele ibe nawo kute ibe nelinani lelifanako ne-A.
quiz.explanation: I-market cap yintengo yelisheya iphindzaphindzwe ngelinani lemasheya. Inkampani A inelinani le-5 million kuphindzaphindzwe nge-{c}200, lokungu-{c}1,000 million. Inkampani B kufanele ifinyelele leliphelele lelifanako nge-{c}10 ngelisheya, ngako idzinga emasheya langu-100 million, kaphindzaphindzwe kangu-20. Intengo yelisheya lephansi ayikutjeli lutfo ngebukhulu benkampani.

22.title: I-P/E Ratio Ichazwa
22.desc: Lisheya libita kakhulu yini nome lishibhile?
22.content:
I-P/E ratio (Intengo-kuya-eNzuzweni) ikutjela kutsi ukhokha malini ngayo yonkhe imali yenzuzo yenkampani (imali: {cName}).

📐 Ifomula: Intengo Yelisheya ÷ Inzuzo Ngelisheya = I-P/E Ratio

Cabanga ngayo njengentengo ngesicheme ngasinye se-pizza 🍕

Nangabe i-pizza A ibita {c}80 ngetincenye leti-8 = {c}10/sicheme
Nangabe i-pizza B ibita {c}100 ngetincenye leti-5 = {c}20/sicheme

I-pizza A ishibhile ngesicheme ngasinye. Kufanana nemasheya:
• I-P/E lephansi (ngaphansi kwa-10) = kungenteka kube yintsengiselo lenhle, NOME imakethe ilindzele kutsi inzuzo yayo YEHLE. I-P/E lephansi ingumbuto, hhayi imphendvulo.
• I-P/E lephakeme (ngetulu kwa-25) = imakethe ilindzele kukhula lokukhulu esikhatsini lesitako. Inkampani bese kufanele ikulethe ngempela.

Njalo cadzanisa i-P/E nalamanye ema-P/E etinkampani letisembonini yinye. Ungacadzanisi i-P/E yelibhange ne-P/E yenkampani yebuchwepheshe!

quiz.q: Inkampani A ine-P/E ye-8. Inkampani B (imboni yinye) ine-P/E ya-30. Loku kusikisela kutsini?
quiz.explanation: I-P/E lephansi isho kukhokha kancane ngeyunithi ngayinye yenzuzo, lokungasho intsengiselo lenhle nome inkampani lesenkingeni. Lesilinganiso siphakamisa umbuto; asiwuphendvuli.
options: Inkampani A ishibhile ngeyunithi ngayinye yenzuzo, kodvwa tfola KUTSI KUNGANI ngembi kwekutsi utsenge
Inkampani B ihlala ikutjala lokuncono kulokubili
I-P/E ratio ayisiti nhlobo etincumweni tekutjala imali

23.title: Kufundza Imiphumela Yetinkampani
23.content:
Ngemuva kwetinyanga letimbalwa, tinkampani tishicilela 'ripoti yato yesikolwa' (njalo ngekota kuletinye timakethe, kabili ngemnyaka kuletinye) futsi inyakatisa tintengo temasheya KAKHULU. Nakhu lokufanele ukubuke:

📊 IMALI LENGENAKO (revenue): Yonkhe imali lengenako ngekutsengisa. Njengekutsi sitolo lesincane sitfole malini sekukonkhe.
💰 INZUZO LEPHELELE (net profit): Loko lokusalako NGEMUVA kwekukhokha tonkhe tindleko. Imali yangempela ekupheleni kwelilanga.
📈 I-EPS (Inzuzo Ngelisheya): Inzuzo ihlukaniswe ngelinani lemasheya. Lisheya ngalinye litfole malini.

Timphawu letinhle: Imali lengenako IYAKHUPHUKA + Inzuzo IYAKHUPHUKA + I-EPS iyakhula = 🟢 intengo ivame kukhuphuka
Timphawu letimbi: Imali lengenako IYEHLA + Inzuzo iyehla = 🔴 intengo ivame kwehla

Sicupho sinye: lokunyakatisa ngempela intengo ngumphumela uma ucadzaniswa naloko imakethe BEYIKULINDZELE. Tinombolo letinhle letifike ngaphansi kwalokulindzelekile tingasehlisa lisheya.

Inkampani ingaba nemali lengenako leningi kodvwa ingabi nanzuzo nhlobo (tindleko letiphakeme). Njalo hlola KOKUBILI!

quiz.q: I-{bank} ibika kutsi imali lengenako ikhuphuke nga-15% kodvwa inzuzo yehle nga-20% ngenca yetindleko letiphakeme. Lolu luphawu loluhle nome lolubi?
quiz.explanation: Imali lengenako yiloko lokungenile, inzuzo yiloko lokusele. Lapha tindleko tikhuphuka ngekushesha kunekutsengisa, ngako inkampani yenta libhizinisi lelinyenti kodvwa igcina lokuncane kulo. Leso secwayiso sangempela, kodvwa akusikuwa, futsi lokulandzelako lokufanele ukutfole kutsi kungani tindleko tikhuphukile.
options: Kuyakhatsatisa, ngobe batsengisa lokunyenti kodvwa bagcina lokuncane kuko
Kunemandla, ngobe imali lengenako lekhuphukako yiyo lebalulekile ngempela
Kubi kakhulu, ngobe inzuzo lehlako isho kutsi inkampani iyehluleka

25.title: Yini i-ETF?
25.content:
Kukhetsa tingoma ngayinye bekuyindlela yinye kuphela yekwakha luhlu lwetingoma. Bese kufika i-Spotify yakunika tinhlu letentiwe kusengaphambili, liciwane lesheshako ngaphandle kwemzamo. 🎵

Ema-ETF (Exchange-Traded Funds) ayi-Spotify yekutjala imali. Esikhundleni sekukhetsa emasheya linye ngalinye, utsenga I-ETF YINYE lephetse sitsanga sonkhe sawo.

Ema-ETF lamanyenti alandzela I-INDEX: luhlu lolushicilelwe lwetinkampani loluhlanganiswe ngekwencwadzi yemitsetfo. {etfDesc} I-ETF ivele itsenge loko lokusohlwini, ngetilinganiso letifanako, futsi iyatibuyeketa nangabe luhlu lushintja.

Ngako i-ETF yinye ye-{etf} ikunika incenye lencane yaloku ngekutsenga kunye: {etfBasket} (emagama lanjenge-{top5}).

⚠️ I-index AYISHO ngekutentakalela 'tinkampani letinkhulu kakhulu'. Letinye tinhlu tihlela ngebukhulu, letinye ngekutsi lisheya lihwetjwa kangakanani, futsi letinye tikhetfwa likomiti. Ema-index lamabili emakethe yinye angaba netinkampani letehluke ngalokuphelele. Njalo fundza kutsi luhlu luyini ngempela ngembi kwekutsi uyitsenge.

Ema-ETF avame kushibha, kulula futsi asabalaliswe kakhulu kunekutsi utikhetsele emasheya. Baphatsi labanyenti betimali labangongcweti abakhoni kuwehlula! 🤯

quiz.q: Utsenga iyunithi yinye ye-ETF ye-{etf}, lelandzela loku: {etfBasket}. Nyalo unani?
quiz.explanation: I-index luhlu lolushicilelwe, futsi i-ETF ye-index itsenga konkhe lokukulo ngetilinganiso letifanako. Ngako iyunithi yinye iphetse sicheme lesincane salo lonkhe libito lelisohlwini, yingako kutsenga kunye sekuvele kusabalalisiwe. Akusilo libito lelikhulu kuphela, futsi akusiyo imali lelindzele imiyalo yakho.
options: Lisheya linye enkampanini lenkhulu kakhulu kulolo luhlu
Incenye lencane yayo yonkhe inkampani kulolo luhlu
Imali i-fund leyibambile kuze uyitjele kutsi itsenge yini

Yabelana ngayo, ngobe basebenti belusito labacinisekisiwe bayayidzinga kute bahlole i-akhawunti yakho
Yabelana ngemagama lasitfupha ekucala kuphela, lokuphephile ngalokwanele
Bacele kutsi bakutfumelele i-imeyili ngelikheli lelisemtsetfweni kucala, bese wabelana ngayo

38.title: Umphatsi Wekhripto
38.content:
Sikhatsi sendzaba yonkhe umuntfu layicaphunako futsi kute muntfu loyixoxa kahle.

Ekucaleni kwa-2017, i-Bitcoin yinye beyibita cishe $1,000. NgaDisemba 2024 yeca $100,000 ngekwekucala. Kutsenga kwe-$1,000, lokubanjwe yonkhe indlela, kwaba cishe $100,000. Loko kuyi-100x. 🤯

Nyalo sicheme lesishiywa ngumdlandla: kute utfole leyo 100x bekufanele uhlale kuko kuwa lokubili lokunesihluku, lokunye kwaba cishe ngu-84% nalokunye cishe ngu-77%, futsi ubuke imali yakho incipha IMINYAKA ngaphandle kwekutsengisa. Cishe kute muntfu lowakhona. Bantfu labanyenti batsenga ngentengo lephakeme, betfuka ekuweni, futsi batsengisa ngentengo lephansi.

Futsi kuyo yonkhe i-Bitcoin kunetinkhulungwane tetinhlavu letafa letaya ku-zero. Kukhetsa lotawuwina kusenesikhatsi kubukeka kulula kuphela nawubuka emuva. Loko kubitwa ngekutsi yi-survivorship bias, futsi kuyinkhohliso lebita kakhulu ekhripto.

Lisifundvo sangempela semshini wesikhatsi: kutinhlavu letasinda, kubeketela kwehlula kukhetsa sikhatsi. Kodvwa utfola kuphela kutsi ngutiphi tinhlavu letisindako NGEMUVA, yingako kusabalalisa kwehlula kukhetsa kwemaciniso, futsi yingako KUTE muntfu lowati likusasa. Ngisho nemphatsi. 🐉
38.bossVictory: Sigaba sekhripto sinqotjiwe. Nyalo wati lokunyenti kunebantfu labadzala labanyenti. 🐉

quiz.q: Tinkhulungwane tetinhlavu tetfulwa kanye ne-Bitcoin, futsi letinyenti nyalo tinelinani lelicishe libe lutfo. Kungani "vele ukhetse i-Bitcoin lelandzelako" kubukeka kulula kangaka nawubuka emuva?
quiz.explanation: Kukhulunywa kuphela ngaleto letasinda, ngako kukhetsa labawinako kubukeka kulula kakhulu nawubuka emuva kunobekunjalo ngaleso sikhatsi. Tinkhulungwane letehluleka atishiyanga simphawu endzabeni.
options: Ngobe labawinako ngibo bodvwa lokusakhulunywa ngabo, futsi labo labafa banyamalala endzabeni
Ngobe tinhlavu letincono kakhulu tibonakala kusukela ekucaleni kunoma ngubani lofundza ngalokwanele ngato
Ngobe tinhlavu letinyenti tigcina tiphumelela kunoma ngubani lobeketelako ngalokwanele kutibamba iminyaka
Ngobe ongcweti babikezela kahle i-Bitcoin emuva nga-2010 futsi babikezele bonkhe labawinako kusukela lapho

39.title: Yini Ngempela I-Blockchain?
39.content:
Susa umdlandla futsi i-blockchain ilula ngendlela lemangalisako: yincwadzi yemarekhodi leyabelwanako emakhompyutha etinkhulungwane agcina emakhophi layo lafanako.

Nangabe lotsite atfumela ikhripto, lokuhweba kungena 'ebhulokhini' kanye nalamanye emakhulu. Libhulokhi livalwa ngetibalo futsi libotjelwe kulibhulokhi lelendlulile. Ngako: libhulokhi. Licheyini. ⛓️

Kungani kunemuntfu lokhatsateka? Ngenca yaloko lokwenta kwenteke:

✅ Kute longahlela umlandvo buthule. Kushintja libhulokhi lelidzala bekutawusho kwenta kabusha onkhe emabhulokhi langemuva kwalo emakhompyutheni etinkhulungwane kanyekanye.
✅ Kute inkampani yinye nome hulumende loyiphetse. Inethiwekhi yemakhompyutha iyiphatsa ndzawonye.
✅ Noma ngubani angahlola lirekhodi. Konkhe kuhweba kwe-Bitcoin lokwake kwentiwa kubonakala emphakatsini.

Lobo buchwepheshe lobusha ngempela. Futsi AKUSIYO imali yemlingo. Lirekhodi lelipheleleko lenhlavu lengenalutfo lisaba yinhlavu lengenalutfo. Kutsi buchwepheshe bungebangempela akwenti tonkhe tinhlavu letakhiwe kubo tibe nelinani. 🧠

quiz.q: Kungani kumatima kangaka kushintja ngemfihlo kuhweba lokudzala ku-blockchain?
quiz.explanation: Libhulokhi ngalinye livalelwe kulelo lelingaphambi kwalo, ngako kubhala kabusha lelidzala kusho kubhala kabusha onkhe emabhulokhi langemuva kwalo, emakhompyutheni etinkhulungwane, ngekushesha kunekutsi inethiwekhi yengete lamasha. Yiloko lokwenta lirekhodi lingapheli ngempela.
options: Onkhe emabhulokhi langemuva bekutawufanele entiwe kabusha nawo
Lushintjo ngalunye kufanele lugunyatwe nguhulumende
Onkhe emarekhodi ladzala kunenyanga ayasulwa
Umdali wenhlavu ngayinye ugcina sikhiya sekuhlela lesiyimfihlo

40.title: I-Bitcoin vs Konkhe Lokunye
40.content:
'Ikhripto' akusiyo intfo yinye. Umehluko ubaluleke kakhulu kunekufana:

₿ I-BITCOIN: yekucala. Linani layo lelikhona livalelwe kutinhlavu letingu-21 million phakadze, kubhalwe kukhodi, futsi lizinga letinhlavu letinsha liyehla ngesigamu cishe njalo ngemuva kweminyaka lemine. (Kuyeva kujwayelekile? Ku-halving kwe-NOOB kuboleka ncamashi lomcabango.) Lonkhe kukhangisa kwayo kuyindlala kanye nekuphepha.

⟠ I-ETHEREUM: incane 'njengegolide ledijithali', yinkhulu 'njengekhompyutha yemhlaba'. Isebentisa ema-smart contract, lokutinhlelo letenteka ngalokutentakalela. Ema-app lamanyenti ekhripto akhiwe kuyo nome kulabaphikisana nayo.

🪙 KONKHE LOKUNYE: tinkhulungwane te-'altcoin'. Letimbalwa tisombulula tinkinga tangempela. Letinyenti ngemakhophi, kuhlola, nome kutsatsa imali. Sibalo lesinesihluku: letinyenti tetinhlavu letake tadalwa setafa nome atinalo linani.

Sifundvo: 'ikhripto iyakhuphuka' ikutjela cishe lutfo nganoma nguyiphi inhlavu LETSITE. Ngayinye ingumbheja wayo, ngematfuba ayo. 🎲

quiz.q: Lingakanani linani lelikhulu le-Bitcoin, futsi lingashintjwa kalula kangakanani?
quiz.explanation: Umkhawulo wa-21 million uyincenye yemitsetfo leyo yonkhe ikhompyutha kunethiwekhi lesebentisako. Kuwukhuphula bekutawusho kutsi cishe onkhe avumelane kwenta loko lasavele aphetse kube nelinani lelincane, yingako umkhawulo utsatfwa njengalongashintjwa.
options: 100 million, futsi labamba (ema-miner) bayavotela ngawo njalo ngemnyaka
21 million, futsi kuwukhuphula cishe akwenteki
1 billion, futsi umdali angawulungisa
Kute umkhawulo nhlobo, ngako tinhlavu letinsha tiphrintwa phakadze

41.title: Ema-stablecoin
41.content:
I-stablecoin yikhripto leyakhelwe kutsi ihlale ibita linani lelingagucuki, ngalokuvamile i-dola yaseMelika le-1 ncamashi. Bahwebi bayisebentisa njengendzawo yekupaka: utsengisa tinhlavu takho letigucuka kakhulu, utingenise ku-stablecoin, bese imali yakho iyahlala ime ngesikhatsi ucabanga ngelinyatselo lelilandzelako.

Tihlala njani ku-$1? Lendlela lenkhulu igcina emadola langempela nemphahla kulondvolotiwe, kute yonkhe inhlavu isekelwe ngalokutsite. Ubeka litsemba lakho kulowo lophetse loko lokulondvolotiwe.

Nayi indzaba yakho yesecwayiso: ema-stablecoin angaPHUKA. Kwake kwenteka ngempela. Nga-2022 i-stablecoin lenkhulu 'ye-algorithm', leyayisebentisa tibalo letihlakaniphile esikhundleni semali yangempela lelondvolotiwe, yawa kusuka ku-$1 yaya cishe ku-zero ngemalanga lambalwa, yashabalalisa emashumi ematigidzigidzi emadola. 'Kutinta' yinhloso yekwakha, akusiso sicinisekiso.

Umtsetfo lolula: nangabe indlela legcina lokutsite 'kuphephile' ihlakaniphe kakhulu, kufanele uyibuke ngekucophelela kakhulu. 🔍

quiz.q: Ngumuphi umsebenti lomkhulu we-stablecoin?
quiz.explanation: Umsebenti we-stablecoin kuhlala ime. Yindzawo yekupaka emkhatsini wekuhweba, akusiyo intfo lekulindzeleke kutsi ikhule.
options: Kugcina linani lelingagucuki, ngalokuvamile $1, kute bahwebi babe nendzawo yekupaka lephephile
Kukhula ngekushesha kunemBitcoin ngekulandzela yonkhe imakethe yekhripto
Kukhokha inzalo ngekutentakalela kunobe ngubani loyiphetse esikhwameni
Kufihla kuhweba kuto tonkhe bantfu ngekuhlakatisa ibhuku lelisobala

42.title: Ikhripto, Intsela neMtsetfo
42.content:
I-inthanethi igcwele bantfu labakholelwa kutsi ikhripto yimali lengabonakali lengenayo imitsetfo. Ngalokuvamile bagcina sebafundze ngendlela lebuhlungu. 😬

Liciniso emaveni lamanyenti, kufaka ekhatsi iNingizimu Afrika:

🧾 INZUZO NGALOKUVAMILE IYATSELWA. Nawutsengisa ikhripto ngemali lenyenti kunaleyo lowayikhokha, sikhungo sentsela ngalokuvamile sifuna sabelo saso, njengasemasheyeni.

🪪 TINKHUNDLA TEKUHWEBA TIYAKWATI KUTSI UNGUBANI. Tinkhundla letisemtsetfweni tidzinga kucinisekiswa kwemazisi (kubitwa ngekutsi yi-KYC, Know Your Customer). Konkhe kuhweba kuphindze kubhalwe phakadze ku-blockchain uqobo, lokuyintfo LEPHIKISANA nekungatiwa.

⚖️ BALAWULI BAKHONA. ENingizimu Afrika, imphahla yekhripto ibukwa ngalokusemtsetfweni njengemikhicito yetetimali, loko lokusho kutsi tinkhundla letiyitsengisako kufanele tilandzele imitsetfo yetinsita tetimali.

Kute kwaloku lokusisizatfu sekwesaba. KODVWA kusizatfu sekungalaleli nobe ngubani lotsi 'imitsetfo ayisebenti ekhriptweni'. Iyasebenta, futsi kutentisa shengatsi akunjalo kungenisa labadzala enkingeni lenkhulu ngempela.

quiz.q: Umzala wakho utsi inzuzo yekhripto ayibonwa sikhungo sentsela ngoba ikhripto ayatiwa kutsi ngeyabani. Yini lengakalungi kuloko?
quiz.explanation: Tinkhundla letisemtsetfweni ticinisekisa kutsi ungubani ngaphambi kwekutsi uhwebe, futsi konkhe kuhweba ku-blockchain kusobala futsi kuhlala phakadze, lokuphikisana nekungatiwa. Inzuzo ngalokuvamile iyatselwa, ngako hlola imitsetfo yalapho uhlala khona.
options: Tinkhundla tiyawahlola emazisi, futsi umlandvo usobala
Kute, ikhripto ayatiwa ngempela
Ikhripto itselwa eMelika kuphela, akukho lenye indzawo
Intsela icala nawukhipha sigidzi

43.title: Kugucuka Kwemanani neMitsetfo Yekusinda
43.content:
Lilanga lelibi emakethe yemasheya li-3%. Lilanga lelibi ekhriptweni li-20%. Ngisho neBitcoin, 'lomdzala' wekhripto, seyake yalahlekelwa ngetulu kwe-80% yenani layo kanyenti futsi yabuye yasimama. Tinhlavu letincane tivame kulahlekelwa ngu-95% tingaphindzi tibuye.

Kungani kunjena? Ikhripto ihwetjwa 24/7 ngaphandle kwetivimbi tekuma, lenyenti yayo itsengwa ngemali lebolekiwe lephocelelwa kutsengiswa nakuwa, futsi emanani ahamba ngetindzaba nemiva kunemibiko yemholo.

Ngako-ke nayi imitsetfo yekusinda, leyo wonkhe umhwebi lonelwati layiphindzaphindzako:

1️⃣ Ungalokotsi ufake imali longeke ukwati kuyilahlekelwa yonkhe.
2️⃣ Lungisa bukhulu betikhundla takho kute inhlekelele yinye ingakucedzi.
3️⃣ Nca kutsi utawuphuma nini NGAPHAMBI kwekutsi ungene, usekhululekile.
4️⃣ I-FOMO ngumuva lobita kakhulu etetimalini.

Tijwayete kotsi kone ku-NoobTrader lapho kulahlekelwa kungesiko kwangempela. Imikhuba ngiwo umvuzo wangempela. 🏆

quiz.q: Nguwuphi kulemitsetfo lomtsetfo wangempela wekusinda emakethe letigucuka kakhulu?
quiz.explanation: Kungalokotsi ubeke engotini imali longeke ukwati kuyilahlekelwa ngiwo umtsetfo lowodvwa lokugcina emdlalweni. Kuphindza kabili sikhundla ngemuva kwekulahlekelwa yindlela ema-akhawunti laphela ngayo.
options: Phindza kabili sikhundla sakho ngemuva kwakho konkhe kulahlekelwa kute ukubuyise
Ungalokotsi utfutse imali longeke ukwati kuyilahlekelwa yonkhe
Kugucuka kwemanani kutsintsa tinhlavu letincane kuphela, ngako tinhlavu letinkhulu tiphephile
Hlala utsenga nangabe wonkhe umuntfu etinkhundleni tekuchumana atsenga

44.title: Imijikelezo Yekudvumisa ne-FOMO
44.content:
Ikhripto ihamba ngemijikelezo yekudvumisa, futsi nawusalibonile liphethini awusoze ukwati kungaliboni:

📈 Sigaba 1: kwenteka lokutsite kwangempela. Labakholwa kucala batsenga bathule.
🚀 Sigaba 2: emanani ayakhuphuka. Tindzaba tiyabona. I-feed yakho igcwala labawinile.
🎪 Sigaba 3: buhlanya. Bashayeli bematekisi banika emathiphu etinhlavu. Bantfu bayaboleka kute batsenge. 'Kulesikhatsi kwehlukile.'
💥 Sigaba 4: kuwa. Labefika sekwephuze, labatsenga ngelinani leliphakeme kakhulu, balahlekelwa kakhulu.
🕳️ Sigaba 5: kuthula. Ema-post alabawinile ayanyamalala. Kute lokhuluma ngekulahlekelwa kwakhe.

Libhamu le-NFT langa-2021 lalandzela lomdlalo ncamashi: tintfo tekucoca te-dijithali betitsengiswa ngetigidzi esicongweni, kwatsi ngemuva kweminyaka lembalwa letinyenti betingasabiti lutfo.

Liceba lelinesihluku labo bonkhe buhlanya: lenta sikhatsi LESIBI KAKHULU sekutsenga sitive njengesikhatsi LESIPHUTFUMAKO kakhulu sekutsenga. Nakutiva kuphephe kakhulu kungena, ngoba wonkhe umuntfu sewungenile, inzuzo lelula ngalokuvamile seyihambile. 🎯

quiz.q: Emjikelezweni wekudvumisa lojwayelekile, umuntfu lojwayelekile uba nesifiso lesikhulu sekutsenga nini?
quiz.explanation: Sifiso sikhulu kakhulu nangabe indzaba ikhuluma kakhulu, futsi indzaba ikhuluma kakhulu ngemuva kwekutsi intsengo seyikhuphukile. Kutsi wonkhe umuntfu sewungenile kwenta kutive kuphephile, futsi yikho futsi lokushiya kungasekho muntfu lotawutsenga.
options: Ekucaleni, nangabe cishe kute lokhuluma ngako
Ehhafini lekuwa, nangabe emanani aphansi
Eduze nesicongo, nangabe wonkhe umuntfu sewungenile
Akulandzeli liphethini, sifiso asihleleki

45.title: Kufundza Likhandlela
45.content: Onkhe emakhandlela asitjela indzatjana lencane ngetinombolo letine kuphela: lapho intsengo ivule khona, lapho ifike khona phetulu kakhulu, lapho yehlele khona phansi kakhulu, nalapho ivale khona. Umtimba lowugcwele usuka ekuvuleni uye ekuvaleni, futsi umbala ukutjela kutsi ngubani lowinile: luhlata lusho kutsi kuvala kugcine ngetulu kwekuvula, lokubovu kusho kutsi batsengisi bayidvonsela ngaphansi. Leliceba lonkhe ngulelo. Fundza kufundza likhandlela linye kahle bese onkhe emashadi emhlabeni ayaguculeka asuke ekubeni ngumsindvo abe yindzaba yetitfombe. 🟢

quiz.q: Lelikhandlela liluhlata. Likutjelani ngaleso sikhatsi sekuhweba?
options: Intsengo ivale iphansi kunalapho ivule khona
Bantfu labanyenti batsengile kunalabatsengisile, kucinisekile
Intsengo ivale iphakeme kunalapho ivule khona
Intsengo ayikange yehle nakancane ngaleso sikhatsi

46.title: Tintsambo Tiyalandzisa
46.content: Umtimba ukhombisa lapho sikhatsi sivule khona nalapho sivale khona, kodvwa tintsambo (wicks) tikhombisa luhambo lonkhe: yonkhe intsengo kulwa lokwafinyelela kuyo ngempela. Intsambo lendze isho kutsi kwaba nemphi lenkhulu ngale kwekuvula nekuvala, futsi lohlangotsi lolushiye intsambo lwehlulwa kuleyo mphi. Intsambo lendze ngaphansi? Batsengisi badvudvuta ngemandla babuyiselwa emuva. Intsambo lendze ngetulu? Batsengi bafinyelela phetulu kodvwa balahlwa. Umtimba siyingcikitsi, tintsambo ngumhlebo. 📏

quiz.q: Yini lekhonjiswa ngempela ngulemigca lemincane (tintsambo) ngetulu nangaphansi kwemtimba?
options: Emanani laphakeme kakhulu nalaphansi kakhulu lahwetjwe ngaleso sikhatsi
Kuvula nekuvala kwatolo
Emanani ncamashi lapho kwentiwe khona kuhweba lokunyenti
Kubikezela kwebubanti bakusasa

47.title: I-Doji
47.content: Ngaletinye tikhatsi likhandlela livula livale cishe ngentsengo lefanako ncamashi, lishiye umtimba lomncane lonetintsambo nhlangotsi tonkhe. Leyo yi-doji, futsi isho kutsi kudvonsana ngentsambo kwaphela ngekulingana: batsengi nebatsengisi badvonse ngemandla sikhatsi sonkhe futsi kute luhlangotsi lolwawina. Iyodvwa imane ifana nekushaya emahlombe. Ngemuva kwekukhuphuka lokunemandla ingakhombisa kutsi umkhuba uyakhatsala, ngoba luhlangotsi lebelulahlula ngekushesha lwehluleka kuhambisa intsengo. Sicondziso lesifanele kunakwa, akusoze kwaba sicinisekiso. 🤝

quiz.q: Likhandlela lelikhanyako livule laphindze lavala cishe ngentsengo lefanako ncamashi. Libitwa ngekutsi yini, futsi likhombisani?
options: I-marubozu, luphawu lwekutimisela lokuphelele kunobe ngumuphi umkhombandlela
Sando, luphawu lwekutsi batsengi babuyisa kulawula
Sikhala, luphawu lwekutsi kuhweba kwama ebusuku
I-doji, luphawu lwekungatinceli emkhatsini webatsengi nebatsengisi

48.title: Sando
48.content: Cabanga ngesikhatsi lesinelunya: batsengisi bashaya intsengo bayehlise, bese batsengi bayibuyisela yonkhe emuva ngaphambi kwekuvala. Loko lokusala eshadini sando (hammer): umtimba lomncane eduze naphetulu kanye nentsambo lendze ngaphansi lebukhulu bayo bungetulu kwekuphindza kabili umtimba. Ngemuva kwekwehla, sando sisho kutsi batsengisi betame sibhakela sabo lesihle kakhulu kodvwa asikashayi. Loko kuvame kukhombisa kujika lokungenteka. Kungenteka, akusetsembiso, ngako kutsatse njengesicondziso sekubuka, hhayi umyalo wekutsenga. 🔨

quiz.q: Ngemuva kwekwehla, likhandlela lelikhanyako likhiphe intsambo lendze ngaphansi nemtimba lomncane eduze naphetulu. Liyini?
options: Inkhanyeti lewako, luphawu lwekutsi batsengisi batsetse kulawula
Sando, sicondziso sekutsi batsengi balwe babuya ngemandla
I-doji, kulingana lokuphelele
Bufakazi bekutsi umkhuba wekwehla sewuphelile

49.title: Inkhanyeti Lewako
49.content: Sitfombe selisibuko lesisando. Ngemuva kwekukhuphuka lokunemandla, batsengi betama kufinyelela entsengweni lensha lephakeme kakhulu, balahlwa kabi, bese intsengo ivala yehlele eduze nalapho ivule khona. Lishadi likhiphe umtimba lomncane ngaphansi kwelikhandlela kanye nentsambo lendze ngetulu: inkhanyeti lewako (shooting star). Kusho kutsi batsengisi bagcine bafikile esicongweni ngemandla lanele kute bawine leso sikhatsi. Ngemuva kwekukhuphuka lokukhulu, lokulahlwa kuvame kubalulekile. Kuvame, hhayi njalo. 🌠

quiz.q: Ngemuva kwekukhuphuka lokunemandla, likhandlela lelikhanyako lagcuma laya etulu labuye lavala eduze nalapho liphansi khona, lashiya intsambo lendze ngetulu. Liyini?
options: Inkhanyeti lewako, sicondziso sekutsi batsengisi bafikile esicongweni
Sando, sicondziso sekutsi batsengi sebaphindze baphetse
I-marubozu leluhlata, emandla ekutsenga lamsulwa
Sicinisekiso sekutsi intsengo itawuwa kusasa

50.title: I-Marubozu
50.content: I-marubozu ngumtimba munye logcwele longenato tintsambo nhlobo: intsengo ivule yamasha ngemkhombandlela munye sikhatsi sonkhe ingakaze ibuke emuva. Kute kulwa, kute kungabata, kutimisela lokuphelele kusuka eluhlangotsini lunye. I-marubozu leluhlata imemeta kuticiniseka kwebatsengi, lebovu imemeta lokuphambene. Ayivamile, futsi yikho lokwenta bahwebi bavuke nayivela. 💪

quiz.q: Likhandlela lelikhanyako ngumtimba munye logcwele longenato tintsambo nhlobo. Lesimo sikutjelani?
options: Kute lohwebile ngaleso sikhatsi, ngako intsengo yahlala ilinganisile
Imakethe yavala ngekushesha ngalelo langa yasinciphisa
Luhlangotsi lunye beluphetse kusukela ekuvuleni kuya ekuvaleni, kutimisela lokuphelele
Batsengi nebatsengisi bebalingana ncamashi kusukela ekucaleni kuya ekugcineni

51.title: Kugwinya Kwekukhuphuka (Bullish Engulfing)
51.content: Emakhandlela lamabili, umlayeto munye. Kucala likhandlela lelibovu lelincane, intfo lejwayelekile emkhubeni wekwehla. Bese kuba nemtimba lomkhulu loluhlata lowuligwinya ngalokuphelele: ngesikhatsi sinye, batsengi bacisha konkhe lokwentiwa batsengisi ngelilanga lelandvulela, nangetulu. Uma kwenteka ngemuva kwemkhuba wekwehla, i-bullish engulfing ngulesinye sezicondziso sekujika lesibukwa kakhulu kunobe ngumuphi lishadi, ngoba sikhombisa kulingana kwemandla kujika ngelikhandlela linye. Sicondziso, hhayi sivumelwano. 🐂

quiz.q: Umtimba lomkhulu loluhlata uwugwinya ngalokuphelele umtimba lobovu longaphambi kwawo. Lelophethini lemakhandlela lamabili liyini?
options: I-bearish engulfing, batsengisi batsetse kulawula
I-bullish engulfing, batsengi babehlula batsengisi
Inzansi lephindziwe (double bottom)
Ema-doji lamabili alandzelana

52.title: Kugwinya Kwekwehla (Bearish Engulfing)
52.content: Sitfombe selisibuko se-bullish. Esicongweni sekukhuphuka, umtimba lomkhulu lobovu ugwinya wonkhe umtimba loluhlata longaphambi kwawo: batsengisi bacisha kutsenga kwelilanga lelandvulela ngelikhandlela linye, khona lapho kukhuphuka bekuse kwelulekile futsi batsengi bakamuva bebatfukutsele. Loko kuvame kwenta nalabanye batsengi batfukutsele. Nawuyibona ngemuva kwekukhuphuka lokudze, yihloniphe. 🐻

quiz.q: Esicongweni sekukhuphuka, umtimba lomkhulu lobovu ugwinya wonkhe umtimba loluhlata longaphambi kwawo. Lelibhangca libitwa ngekutsi yini?
options: I-bullish engulfing, kukhuphuka kuyachubeka
Sando lesilandzelwa yi-doji
Kuphuma ngetulu kwe-resistance
I-bearish engulfing, batsengisi babehlula batsengi

53.title: Kubona Umkhuba Wekukhuphuka
53.content: Umkhuba wekukhuphuka udzinga tinhlangotsi totimbili: ticongo letiphakeme kakhulu FUTSI tinzansi letiphakeme kakhulu. Sicongo ngasinye sehlula lesendlulile, futsi kwehla ngakunye kuma kuphakeme kunalokwandvulela, ngoba batsengi bachubeka bangena ngekushesha njalo. Lesimo sesitebhisi yimakethe ikutjela kutsi sidzingo siphetse. Sicongo lesinye lesiphakeme sisodvwa asifakazi lutfo. Liphethini libhangca, liphindzaphindzeka. 📈

quiz.q: Sicongo ngasinye sehlula lesendlulile, futsi kwehla ngakunye kuma kuphakeme kunalokwandvulela. Lelishadi likhombisani?
options: Umkhuba wekukhuphuka, ticongo letiphakeme netinzansi letiphakeme
Umkhuba wekwehla, ticongo letiphansi netinzansi letiphansi
Libanga, intsengo ibambeke emkhatsini wephansi neluphahla
Sicongo lesiphindziwe (double top) lesisakheka

54.title: Kubona Umkhuba Wekwehla
54.content: Phendvula sitebhisi sibe phansi phetulu. Ticongo letiphansi tisho kutsi batsengisi bahlasela ngekushesha ngako konkhe kugcuma, tinzansi letiphansi tisho kutsi batsengi babuyela emuva kakhulu ngako konkhe kwehla. Nangabe lesakhiwo sisame, batsengisi baphetse umbukiso, futsi kulwa naso yindlela bahwebi labasha labanika ngayo imali kulabanesineke. Umkhuba awusiso sitsa sakho, kodvwa kutentisa shengatsi awukho ngempela sitsa. 📉

quiz.q: Konkhe kugcuma kuphela kuphansi kunalokwendlulile, futsi konkhe kwehla kujula kakhulu. Ubuke yini?
options: Umkhuba wekukhuphuka lophumulako nje
Libanga lelihamba ngeceleni
Umkhuba wekwehla, ticongo letiphansi netinzansi letiphansi
Liphethini le-bullish engulfing lelisakheka

55.title: Imakethe Lehamba Ngeceleni
55.content: Ngaletinye tikhatsi kute luhlangotsi loluwinako, ngako intsengo imane igcumagcuma emkhatsini wephansi lelifanako neluphahla lolufanako ematsatsu lamanyenti. Lelo libanga (range), futsi emakethe achitsa sikhatsi lesinyenti kakhulu sekuphila kwawo enta loku ncamashi. Ayikaphuki futsi ayiyisicefe, yimakethe iphumula. Bahwebi labanesineke bafundza kukutsandza kulindza, ngoba nangabe libanga lihlala sikhatsi lesidze, kuphuma kwekugcina kuvame kuba nemchumo lomkhulu. 🏓

quiz.q: Ematsatsu lamanyenti intsengo igcumagcuma emkhatsini wephansi lelifanako neluphahla lolufanako. Loku kubitwa ngekutsi yini?
options: Umkhuba wekukhuphuka, uchubeka utsintsa luphahla
Libanga, imakethe ihamba ngeceleni
Inhloko nemahlombe
Kuphuma lokusachubeka

56.title: Sisekelo (Support)
56.content: Nangabe intsengo ichubeka yehlela ezingeni lelifanako bese igcuma njalo, bahwebi lelo zinga balibita ngekutsi sisekelo (support): liphansi lapho batsengi bachubeka banca kutsi intsengo yi-bargain. Nangabe sime tikhatsi letinyenti, bantfu labanyenti bayasibuka, futsi loko kuyincenye yesizatfu sekutsi sichubeke sime. Kodvwa khumbula kutsi liphansi lidvwetjwa bantfu, hhayi umtsetfo. Sisekelo singaphuka futsi siyaphuka, futsi nasiphuka, sicumbi lesigcumako siba sicumbi lesetfukako. 🧱

quiz.q: Intsengo yehlele ezingeni lelifiphele katsatfu, futsi yagcuma njalo. Bahwebi lelo zinga balibita ngekutsi yini?
options: I-resistance, luphahla lapho batsengisi bangena khona ngebunyenti
Lilayini lemkhuba, emazinga kufanele abe tidiyagonali
I-stop-loss lebekwe yimakethe
Sisekelo, liphansi lapho batsengi bachubeka bangena khona

57.title: I-Resistance
57.content: I-resistance iluphahla: lizinga lapho konkhe kukhuphuka kuchubeka kuma ngoba batsengisi bayajabula kutsatsa imali yabo lapho. Buka lishadi lishaya inhloko yalo entsengweni lefanako katsatfu, bese ubuka i-resistance isebenta khona manje. Naku lokujika lokufanele ukukhumbule: nangabe intsengo ike iphumelela ngekutimisela lokungempela, loluphahla ludzala luvame kucala kusebenta njengaphansi lelisha. 🪟

quiz.q: Kukhuphuka lokutsatfu lokuhlukene kume ezingeni lelifiphele. Lelo zinga libitwa ngekutsi yini?
options: I-resistance, luphahla lapho batsengisi bachubeka badvudvuta emuva
Sisekelo, liphansi lelingaphansi kwentsengo
Lizinga lenzuzo yemasheya (dividend), lelibekwa kanye ngemnyaka
Kukhuphuka kwevolumu, lokungasho lutfo ngentsengo

58.title: Emalayini Emkhuba
58.content: Hlanganisa tinzansi letikhuphukako eshadini futsi usuwudvwebe lilayini lemkhuba (trendline). Noma ngumaphi emaphoyinti lamabili enta lilayini, kodvwa kutsintsa kwesitsatfu ngulapho licala khona kufakazela kutsi libalulekile, ngoba kukhombisa kutsi batsengi bachubeka bavikela lizinga lelifanako lelikhuphukako. Konkhe kutsintsa lokwengetiwe lokuhlonishwako kubufakazi lobunyenti. Kuhlala kubufakazi, akusoze kwaba setsembiso: lilayini lemkhuba luphawu lwepensela, hhayi ludvonga lwemandla. ✏️

quiz.q: Lelilayini lelikhuphukako litsintswe katsatfu ngetikhatsi letehlukene. Kungani bahwebi bakhatsalela kutsi lilayini lemkhuba litsintswe kangaki?
options: Abakukhatsaleli, ngoba noma ngumaphi emaphoyinti lamabili enta lilayini lemkhuba libe ngumtsetfo
Kutsintsa kutsatfu kusho kutsi kugcuma kwesine kucinisekisiwe kulandzela
Kutsintsa lokunyenti kwenta lilayini libaluleke kakhulu, batsengi bachubeka balivikela
Emalayini emkhuba abalwa emashadini emalanga kuphela, akusoze kube kulamafushane

59.title: Imizila (Channels)
59.content: Umzila (channel) ngumkhuba lonemikhuba lemihle. Intsengo iyakhuphuka igcumagcuma emkhatsini wemalayini lamabili lalinganako: liphansi lelenziwe tinzansi letikhuphukako neluphahla lolwenziwe ticongo letikhuphukako, kuhamba kunyuke ndzawonye njengetinhlangotsi temgwaco. Bahwebi babuka tonkhe tinhlangotsi kute babone kugcuma, futsi babuka kakhulu lilanga lapho intsengo iphuma emzileni, ngoba kuphuma lokucacile emzileni kuvame kuba ngulapho kucala khona kunyakatfa lokukhulu lokulandzelako. 🛣️

quiz.q: Intsengo iyakhuphuka igcumagcuma emkhatsini wemalayini lamabili lalinganako. Leliphethini liyini?
options: Unxantathu, lapho emalayini lamabili kufanele ahlangane
Umzila lokhuphukako, umkhuba wekukhuphuka lonemzila lobonakalako
Sicongo lesiphindziwe (double top)
Libanga lelilinganisile lelingayi ndzawo nhlobo

60.title: Sicongo Lesiphindziwe (Double Top)
60.content: Intsengo ishaya luphahla lolufanako kabili, yehluleke kabili, idvwebe i-M lenkhulu eshadini. Nayiphuka ngaphansi kwekwehla lokusemkhatsini (lilayini lentsamo, neckline) sicongo lesiphindziwe siphelele: sicondziso sakudzala sekujika kwekwehla. Sitfombe saso selisibuko, i-W, yinzansi lephindziwe (double bottom), futsi ikhomba ngalokunye luhlangotsi. Kuvame kukhombisa sicongo, akufanele kube njalo. Kute lokufanele kube njalo eshadini. Ⓜ️

quiz.q: Intsengo yashaya luphahla lolufanako kabili, yehluleka kabili, yabese iphuka ngaphansi kwekwehla lokusemkhatsini. Lesimo siyini?
options: Inzansi lephindziwe, sicondziso sekukhuphuka
Umzila lokhuphukako
Sando
Sicongo lesiphindziwe, sicondziso sekujika kwekwehla

61.title: Nangabe Emaphethini Ehluleka
61.content: Lesi ngulesifundvo lesibaluleke kakhulu kulesigaba. Liphethini lasencwadzini lakheka, wonkhe umuntfu walibona, bese imakethe yenta lokuphambene. Onkhe emaphethini lowafundzile ayehluleka ngaletinye tikhatsi, futsi loko akusilo lishadi likucambela emanga, ngulo lishadi likunika lwati: luhlangotsi lowalusekela selwehlulekile. Nca kutsi utawuphuma nini ngaphambi kwekungena, futsi nangabe liphethini lehluleka, tsatsa lesicondziso uphume. Emaphethini ngemathuba, akusoze kwaba tetsembiso. 🚪

quiz.q: Inzansi lephindziwe lesencwadzini yakheka eliphansi lelifiphele... bese intsengo yawa yadlula khona kulo. Ngusiphi sifundvo lesiliciniso?
options: Emaphethini ngemathuba, hhayi tetsembiso, futsi liphethini lelehlulekile luphawu lwakho lwekuphuma
Tinzansi letiphindziwe tangempela atisoze tehluleka, ngako lebewuyibuka bekufanele kube ngumgunyatso
Tsenga lokunyenti ngentsengo lephansi, ngoba liphethini lisatawugcina lentekile
Emashadi ayayeka kusebenta nhlobo nangabe liphethini selehlulekile kuwe kanjalo

62.title: Inhloko Nemahlombe
62.content: Ticongo letintsatfu: lesidze kakhulu emkhatsini (inhloko), lesiphansi ngakunye luhlangotsi (emahlombe), kanye nelilayini ngaphansi kwekwehla lokubili lelibitwa ngekutsi lilayini lentsamo (neckline). Kwakheka nangabe batsengi bakhona kudvudvuta kwekugcina lokuphakeme, bese bangakhoni ngisho kukulingana ekuzameni lokulandzelako. Lesimo sisodvwa siyisecwayiso kuphela. Incenye bahwebi labayilindza ngempela kuphuka lokucacile ngaphansi kwelilayini lentsamo, ngoba ngulapho liphethini liyeka khona kuba ngumdvwebo licale kuba sincumo. 👤

quiz.q: Ticongo letintsatfu: lesidze kakhulu emkhatsini, lesiphansi ngakunye luhlangotsi, neliphansi lelihlanganisa kwehla lokubili. Ngusiphi lesimo sakudzala?
options: Inzansi lephindziwe katsatfu, tinzansi letintsatfu letilinganako ngaphambi kwekudvudvuta kuya etulu
Inhloko nemahlombe, kuphela lokungenteka kwemkhuba wekukhuphuka
Unxantathu lokhuphukako
Tisando letintsatfu letilandzelanako, ngasinye silahla emanani laphansi

63.title: Kucindzetela Kwenxantathu
63.content: Nangabe kunyakatfa kuchubeka kuncipha, tinzansi letiphakeme ticindzetela ticongo letiphansi, imakethe iyasonga njengesipringi. Loko ngunxantathu (triangle): tinhlangotsi totimbili tiphelelwa yindzawo, kucindzetelwa sincumo. Kucindzetela kuvame kuphela ngekuchuma, futsi nangu lugibe: umkhombandlela wekuchuma awatiwa ngaphambili. Lindza kuphuka esikhundleni sekukucagela. Imakethe itakutjela, futsi ayikubiti lutfo ngalolwati. 🌀

quiz.q: Kunyakatfa kuchubeka kuncipha, kucindzetela intsengo kube sisongo lesincane ngekwengeteka, kuze kugcine kuchumile. Sisongo besiyini?
options: Umzila, emalayini lamabili lalinganako langakaze ahlangane nhlobo
Sicongo lesiphindziwe
Unxantathu, kuhlangana lokuvame kuphela ngekuphuma
Bufakazi bekutsi intsengo bekufanele iphuke iye etulu kusukela lapha

64.title: Ivolumu: Umtjini Wemanga
64.content: Ivolumu (volume) yinombolo yemasheya lashintje tandla, futsi ngumtjini wemanga wemashadi. Kuphuma ngevolumu lencane kakhulu kuhlebela lokukhohlisa bantfu: kuhweba lokumbalwa kwasunduza intsengo kuya lapho ingeke ihlale khona. Kuphuma ngevolumu lenkhulu sicumbi sivota ngempela ngemali. Kunyakatfa kwentsengo lokufanako, inchazelo leyehluke ngalokuphelele. Ngaphambi kwekutsi ukholwe noma ngukuphi kunyakatfa lokukhulu, hlola kutsi ngubani lowafika kuko. 🔊

quiz.q: Kutama kubili kwekuphunyula eluphahleni lolufanako: kwekucala ngevolumu lencane kwehluleka, kwesibili kwefika nevolumu lenkhulu kwasimama. Ivolumu yentani lapha?
options: Kute nhlobo, ivolumu ayikaze ibaluleke ekunyakatfeni kwentsengo
Iphocelela intsengo kutsi ikhuphuke, ngoba ivolumu lephakeme isunduza emanani etulu
Ibikezela sicongo ncamashi sekunyakatfa ngaphambi kwekutsi kwenteke
Isebenta njengekucinisekisa, ivolumu lenkhulu ikhombisa kutimisela kwangempela ngemuva kwekunyakatfa

65.title: Umboni Wemkhuba
65.desc: Emashadi lalishumi, kute emalebula, kute sihawu
65.content: Emashadi lalishumi. Kute emalebula, kute emalayini ekusita, kute ticondziso. Sho kutsi linye ngalinye likhombisani, ncamashi njengemhwebi wangempela agcolote sikrini sangempela. Tfola 8 kulokuli-10 bese lesigaba sesingesakho. Utfola kutama lokuntsatfu ngelilanga, ngako yehlisa ijubane, fundza emakhandlela, futsi ukhumbule sifundvo lesibaluleke kakhulu kunato tonkhe: ngaletinye tikhatsi imphendvulo leliciniso kutsi kute liphethini nhlobo. 🕯️

66.title: Kute Lokungewakho Lapha
66.content:
Konkhe lokufundzile kuze kube manje bekunentfo ngemuva kwako. Tsenga lisheya le-{retail} futsi uba nencenye yenkampani: incenye yetitolo, incenye yenzuzo, livoti emhlanganweni, kanye nenzuzo yemasheya (dividend) nangabe bayikhokha.

I-derivative akusiko loko.

I-CFD (contract for difference) sivumelwano emkhatsini wakho nemhlinzeki sekushintjisana ngumehluko wentsengo emkhatsini wekutsi uvula nini nekutsi uvala nini. Lowo ngumkhicito wonkhe. Nangabe i-{retail} ikhuphuka futsi bewubheja kutsi iyakhuphuka, bakukhokhela umehluko. Nangabe yehla, wena ubakhokhela. Kute lotsenga lisheya. Kute lotsengisa lisheya. Kute emasheya lakhona kunobe kuphi kulokuhweba.

I-future sivumelwano sekutsenga nobe kutsengisa lokutsite ngentsengo lebekiwe ngelusuku lolubekiwe. Letangempela tiphela ngemabhalela ngempela emafutsa nobe ngemathani embila, kodvwa cishe kute lotigcina sikhatsi lesidze kangako, ngako ngekwenta ema-future lamanyenti nawo amane abe kubheja enombolweni lokunelilanga lekugcina.

Kungani loku kubaluleke kakhulu kunaloko lokuvakala ngako:

• Kute tinzuzo temasheya. Kute Bantwana Bemali. Intfo leyakha ngekuthula lokunyenti kwembuyiselo esifundvweni 15 imane ingekho lapha.
• Kute livoti, kute bunikati, kute lokufanele ukugcine. Kute indlela yekutsi "ngitawumane ngikugcine iminyaka lelishumi", ngoba kute lokufanele ukugcine.
• Kute kukhula kwenzalo lekhulako (compounding). Lonkhe lolu-app luchitsa tifundvo letingu-65 lukufundzisa kutsi sikhatsi singakuwe. Kulelikamelo, sikhatsi sikubita imali. Utawubona kutsi malini ncamashi esifundvweni 72.

Konkhe losukwati kusabalulekile. Kumane kuyeke kuba yintfo loyentako. 📄

quiz.q: Uvula i-CFD ku-{retail} bese intsengo iyakhuphuka. Yini lonayo ngempela?
quiz.explanation: I-CFD sivumelwano emkhatsini wakho nemhlinzeki sekushintjisana ngumehluko emkhatsini wentsengo ngesikhatsi uvula nentsengo ngesikhatsi uvala. Kute lotsenga lisheya, kute lolitsengisako, futsi kute lakhona kunobe kuphi kulesivumelwano. Ngiko nje kungekho nzuzo yemasheya, kungekho livoti futsi kungekho lokufanele ukugcine iminyaka lelishumi.
options: Emasheya umhlinzeki lawagcine ngeligama lakhe
Sivumelwano sekushintjisana ngumehluko wentsengo ekugcineni
Incenye yenkampani, nenzuzo yemasheya lelandzelako
Livawusha leliphenduka emasheya angempela nawuvala

67.title: Kuboleka Kumngani
