I-leverage ivakala shengatsi yintfo yebuchwepheshe. Akusiyo. Kuboleka.

Asitsi ufuna emasheya ayi-{c}1,000 kodvwa unayi-{c}200 kuphela. Umngani utsi utawufaka leyi-{c}800 lesele. Ulawula emasheya ayi-{c}1,000 ngayi-{c}200 yemali yakho. Leyo yi-leverage. Lowo ngumcondvo wonkhe.

Manje nati tintfo letintsatfu lomngani latentako. Udzinga totintsatfu, ngaphandle kwaloko utsengiselwe inganekwane.

1️⃣ INZUZO NGEYAKHO NGEMPELA. Emasheya akhuphuka nge-10%. Yakho yi-{c}1,000 manje seyi-{c}1,100. Loko kuyinzuzo yayi-{c}100 futsi uyigcina yonkhe, ngoba umngani wakho ukweleta yi-{c}800 kuphela, kute lokwengetiwe (imali: {cName}). Ku-{c}200 yakho, i-{c}100 kuyinzuzo ye-50%. Kunyakatfa kwe-10% kwakwentela 50%. Le yincenye wonkhe umuntfu layifakako.

2️⃣ SIKWELETU ASINCIPHI NAWUNGACINISEKI. Le yincenye kute loyifakako, futsi isifundvo sonkhe. Esikhundleni saloko emasheya ehla nge-10%. Yakho yi-{c}1,000 manje seyi-{c}900. Usakweleta umngani wakho yonkhe i-{c}800. Hhayi i-{c}720. Yonkhe i-{c}800. Ngako konkhe kwehla kwayi-{c}100 kuphuma esabelweni SAKHO, futsi yakho yi-{c}200 manje seyi-{c}100. Kunyakatfa kwe-10% kwakulahlekisela 50%.

Phindza ufundze letimbili. Umngani lofanako, i-10% lefanako. Imali yakho ihamba ngejubane lelingemahlandla lasihlanu nhlangotsi totimbili, ngoba sikweletu asikaze sitsatse sabelo sebuhlungu.

3️⃣ UMNGANI UKHOKHISA IRENTI, MALANGA ONKHE, KUKO KONKHE. Hhayi ku-{c}800 yakhe. Kuyo yonkhe i-{c}1,000 loyilawulako. Bonkhe busuku loyigcina ngabo, nobe intsengo ikhuphukile, yehlile, nobe ingayanga ndzawo.

Futsi kunentfo yesine lecashe ngekhatsi kwalena yesitsatfu. Nangabe i-{c}200 yakho iba ncane, umngani wakho akakushayeli kute nikhulume ngako. Uyatsengisa. Ngekushesha, ngekutentakalela, nobe ngayiphi intsengo lekhona, ngoba yi-{c}800 yakhe lesengotini futsi akalindzi imibono yakho. Loko kunelibito, futsi utawukuhlangabeta ngemuva kwetifundvo letintsatfu: liquidation.

Ngako: inzuzo lenkhulu, kulahlekelwa lokukhulu, irenti bonkhe busuku, nemunwe walomunye enkinobhweni yekutsengisa. I-leverage akusiyo imali yamahhala lenengoti lencane. Sikweletu lesinato tonkhe letine, futsi ema-advert akhombisa kuphela yekucala. 🧠

quiz.q: Umngani ufaka 800 NT, wena ufaka 200 NT, futsi nindzawonye nilawula emasheya a-1,000 NT. Emasheya ehla nge-10%. Dvonsa uye kulokubitwa yi-200 NT yakho manje.
quiz.explanation: Sikweletu asinciphi nawungaciniseki. Emasheya manje abita 900 NT futsi umngani wakho usakweletwa yonkhe i-800 NT, ngako 100 NT yiyo lesele kuwe. Kwehla kwe-10% kwemasheya kwatsatsa ingcenye yemali yakho, ngoba sikweletu asitsatsi lutfo ebuhlungwini. Kuhamba ngendlela lefanako nakukhuphuka, futsi leyo yingcenye lekhonjiswa ngema-advert.

68.title: I-Margin Yidiphozithi, Akusiko Kutsenga
68.content:
Nawutsenga lisheya nge-{c}100, leyo {c}100 seyiphumile emalini yakho bese lisheya lihlala ku-akhawunti yakho. Kushintjisana lokulula.

I-margin ayisebenti kanjalo. Nawuvula sikhundla lesine-leverage ubeka idiphozithi, futsi leyo diphozithi akusiyo inkhokhelo yalutfo. Yidiphozithi yekuvikela kulahlekelwa kwakho. Ihlala lapho, ikhiyiwe, futsi sikhundla siyayidla nangabe intsengo ihamba iphambene nawe.

Asitsi lizinga lediphozithi li-25%. Ubeka 250 NT futsi ulawula kubeka engotini (exposure) kwe-1,000 NT. Buka i-akhawunti yakho:

• Intsengo ingagucuki: i-250 yakho isese-250. Ngaphandle kwekutsi i-financing seyicalile, ngako ngekuthula seyincane.
• Intsengo yehle nge-5%: sikhundla silahlekelwe ngu-50 NT. Idiphozithi yakho empeleni seyi-200. Imali yakho lekhululekile ayikanyakati. I-akhawunti yakho seyincane.
• Intsengo yehle nge-20%: sikhundla silahlekelwe ngu-200 NT. Idiphozithi yakho seyehlele ku-50. Awentanga lutfo. Awutsengisanga lutfo. Ubukile.

Emagama lamatsatfu lasesikrinini ngasinye kulelikamelo:

🔒 I-MARGIN LESETJENTISIWE: yonkhe idiphozithi lonayo njenga kunyalo.
💰 LINANI LE-AKHAWUNTI (EQUITY): imali yakho lekhululekile, kuhlanganiswe ne-margin yakho lebekiwe, kuhlanganiswe nobe kususwe inzuzo nekulahlekelwa kwato tonkhe tikhundla letivuliwe, kususwe i-financing lekhokhisiwe kuze kube nyalo. Loko lokubitwa yi-akhawunti yakho ngempela nangabe konkhe kuvalwa khona manje.
📊 LIZINGA LE-MARGIN: i-equity ihlukaniswe nge-margin lesetjentisiwe. Ngetulu kwe-100% unemcamelo. Ngaphansi kwe-100% imakethe seyiwucedzile umcamelo seyicale ediphozithini.

Nemtsetfo munye lomangalisa wonkhe umuntfu: i-margin ilinganiswa ku-akhawunti yakho yonkhe, hhayi ngesikhundla ngasinye. Sikhundla lesilahlekelwako sidla sibambiso lesisekela lesiwinako. Ngiko nje kutsi "lokunye kuhweba kwami kuhle" akusiko kutivikela. 🔒

quiz.q: Lizinga lediphozithi li-25%, ngako 250 NT yemali yakho ilawula kubeka engotini kwe-1,000 NT. Intsengo yehla nge-8% ungenti lutfo nhlobo. Dvonsa uye kulokwakubita kona lokwehla.
quiz.explanation: Idiphozithi akusiyo inkhokhelo yalutfo, isibambiso, futsi kulahlekelwa kubalwa kuyo yonkhe i-1,000 NT loyilawulako. I-8% ye-1,000 NT ngu-80 NT. Awutsengisanga lutfo futsi imali yakho lekhululekile ayikanyakati, kodvwa 80 NT ye-250 NT yediphozithi yakho idliwe futsi i-akhawunti yakho incane ngu-80 NT. Bala i-8% ediphozithini esikhundleni saloko utfole 20 NT, lokuliphutsa lelenta i-leverage ibonakale ingenangoti.

69.title: I-Margin Call
69.content:
I-margin call ngumzuzu lapho lizinga le-margin yakho lehla ngaphansi kwe-100%. Ngemagama lalula: umcamelo wenzuzo yakho sewuphelile futsi imakethe seyicale kudla idiphozithi uqobo.

Nakhu kutsi kutiva njani ngempela, ngoba indlela yencwadzi ishiya incenye lebalulekile.

Ayikaze ifike ngelilanga lelihle. Ifika nangabe sikhundla sesibi kakhulu, nangabe sewutitjele kabili kutsi sitawubuya, futsi nangabe ungakhoni kakhulu kwenta sincumo lesinekuthula. Akusiso secwayiso lesinenhlonipho. Ngumyalo: faka imali leyengetiwe, nobe uvale tikhundla, nobe umhlinzeki akwentele kona.

Unemanyatselo lamatsatfu futsi mabili kuphela lawakho.

1️⃣ VALA lokutsite. Loku kukhulula i-margin ngekushesha futsi cishe njalo kuyimphendvulo lelungile. Kuphindze kusho kuvuma kutsi bewungakalungi, lokusizatfu sangempela lesenta bantfu bangakwenti.
2️⃣ ENGETA imali. Loku akulungisi lutfo. Kukutsengela indzawo yekungalungi sikhatsi lesidze, esikhundleni lesesewusikhetse kabi, ngemali bewungakahleli kuyibeka engotini. Kwengeta imali nakune-margin call yindlela kuhweba lokubi lokuba yinyanga lembi ngayo.
3️⃣ UNGENTI LUTFO. Bese linyatselo lesitsatfu lenteka ngaphandle kwakho, futsi linelibito.

Balawuli bakutsatsa loku ngalokumcoka kangangekutsi babhala inombolo emtsetfweni. Tinkampani te-Europe, e-UK nase-Australia kufanele tivale ngekutentakalela tikhundla temtsengi lojwayelekile nangabe i-margin yakhe yehlela ku-50% yaloko lebekudzingeka. Hhayi "kufanele" nje. Kuphocelelekile. Babhala lowo mtsetfo ngoba nangabe bantfu bashiywa kutsi batincumele, bakhetsa indlela 3 balahlekelwa kwendlula loko bebanako. ⚠️

quiz.q: Lizinga le-margin yakho lehlele ku-80% futsi useku-margin call. Nguyiphi imphendvulo lenciphisa ngempela ingoti ye-liquidation kunekumane uyiphuze?
quiz.explanation: Kuvala kubuyisela idiphozithi masinyane, ngako lizinga le-margin lingcamuka ngekushesha. Kwengeta imali kumane kutsenge indzawo yekungalungi sikhatsi lesidze ekuhwebeni lesewukukhetse kabi. Kulindza yindlela i-liquidation leyenteka ngayo. Futsi sikhundla sesibili ngalokunye luhlangotsi sidzinga idiphozithi yaso, ngako sisebentisa i-margin lenyenti, hhayi lencane.
options: Kufaka imali leyengetiwe ku-akhawunti
Kulindza kutsi lizinga le-margin libuye likhuphuke
Kuvala lesinye setikhundla lotivulile
Kuvula sikhundla sesibili ngalokunye luhlangotsi

70.title: I-Liquidation, Nentsengo Lokufanele Uyati Kucala
70.desc: Intsengo ncamashi lapho i-akhawunti yakho ifika ku-zero
70.content:
I-liquidation kuvalwa kwetikhundla takho ngumhlinzeki ngoba idiphozithi yakho cishe seyiphelile. Kwenteka ngekutentakalela. Kwenteka masinyane. Kute lobuta umbono wakho, kute lohlola kutsi bewusetawuba ngulolungile yini, futsi kute kudlulisela licala.

Inombolo lebaluleke kakhulu kulesigaba sonkhe yi-INTSENGO YE-LIQUIDATION yakho: intsengo yangempela, ngemali yangempela (nge-{cPlural}), lapho loko kwenteka khona.

Hhayi liphesenti. Intsengo. Ngoba "ungalahlekelwa yidiphozithi yakho" ngumusho longawuvumela ngenhloko bese uyakhohlwa, kantsi "{tech} ku-{c}87.40 futsi i-akhawunti yakho ayinalutfo" liciniso longalihlola elishadini ngaphambi kwekutsi ucindzetele lutfo.

Sikrini ngasinye kulelikamelo siyikhombisa ngaphambi kwekutsi uvume, idvwetjwe esikalini sentsengo lesifanako nelishadi kute ubone kutsi ikhashane kangakanani ngempela. Tintfo letimbili utawutibona masinyane, futsi totimbili tisifundvo:

📏 Idiphozithi lenkhulu isunduta intsengo ye-liquidation kuya kudze. Imali yakho lenyenti lefakiwe isho kutsi intsengo kufanele yehle kakhulu ngaphambi kwekutsi imali yakho iphele.
⚡ Idiphozithi lencane iyidvonsela eduze khona nentsengo yalamuhla. Ngediphozithi ye-10%, i-liquidation cishe ikhashane ngekunyakatfa kwe-10%, futsi kunyakatfa kwe-10% liviki lelijwayelekile.

Bese kuba nelugibe leliciniso. Intsengo ye-liquidation ngulapho injini ihlose kukuvala khona, hhayi lapho kucinisekisiwe kutsi utawuphuma khona. Nangabe tindzaba letimbi tifika ebusuku futsi imakethe ivula kabusha ngaphansi kakhulu kwalelo zinga, uvalwa nobe ngayiphi intsengo imakethe lengayikhokha ngempela. Leso sikhala (gap), futsi sifundvo 78 sikhuluma ngaso.

Yati intsengo yakho ye-liquidation ngaphambi kwekutsi uvule. Nangabe ungeke ukhone kuyisho ngelivi, awukuvisisi kuhweba lotsatsa kukwenta. 💀

quiz.q: Ubeka 200 NT njengediphozithi kute ulawule 1,000 NT yemphahla lenentsengo ye-100 NT. Dvonsa intsengo uyehlise lapho idiphozithi yakho iphela khona.
quiz.explanation: Ulawula ema-unit langu-10, ngako yonkhe i-1 NT intsengo leyehla ngayo ikubita 10 NT. Idiphozithi yakho ye-200 NT iphela ku-80 NT, lokukwehla kwe-20% kuphela.

71.title: Indlela Yekubuya Ibhekise Etulu Kakhulu
71.desc: Kungani kulahlekelwa kulukhuni kukulungisa kunaloko lokubonakala ngako
71.content:
Kulahlekelwa nenzuzo kutiva shengatsi kuphambene. Akunjalo, futsi tibalo atisedvute nekufana.

Ulahlekelwe yi-10%? Udzinga +11% kute ubuye. Kuyacansula, kulungile.
Ulahlekelwe yi-50%? Udzinga +100%. Kufanele UPHINDZE KABILI kute nje ulingane.
Ulahlekelwe yi-75%? Udzinga +300%.
Ulahlekelwe yi-90%? Udzinga +900%.

Sizatfu silula nawusasibona: inzuzo ibalwa esicumbini lesincane lesisele kuwe. I-100 yehlela ku-50, futsi kute ukhuphuke kusuka ku-50 ubuyele ku-100 leso sicumbi lesincane kufanele siphindze kabili.

Manje engeta i-leverage, futsi ubone kutsi yentani ngempela. Ayenti nje inzuzo yakho ishesha. Ikwehlisela phansi kulelithebula ngentsambama yinye. Kwehla kwe-12% kwelisheya, lokuliviki lelibi kodvwa lelijwayelekile ngalokuphelele, kushaya i-akhawunti yakho nge-48% ngediphozithi ye-25%. Manje udzinga +92% kute ubuyele lapho ucale khona, ngenca yeliviki lelacishe lingabikwa etindzabeni.

Ngiko nje bachwepheshe bakhuluma ngekuvikela imali yabo (capital) ngaphambi kwekutsi bakhulume nganobe yini lenye, futsi ngiko nje "ngitawuyibuyisa" kungumusho lobita kakhulu ekuhwebeni. Kuyibuyisa kulukhuni ngetibalo kunekuyilahlekelwa, njalo nje. ⛰️

quiz.q: I-akhawunti yakho yehle nge-75%. Dvonsa uye enzuzweni loyidzingako kusuka lapha kute nje ubuyele lapho ucale khona.
quiz.explanation: I-100 NT yehlela ku-25 NT. Kute ifike ku-100 futsi leyo 25 kufanele iphindzwe kane, lokuyinzuzo ye-300%. Kukhuphuka kulinganiswa esicumbini lesincane lesisele kuwe, ngiko nje kubhekise etulu kakhulu kunekwehla.

72.title: Irenti Yemali Lebolekiwe
72.content:
Waboleka kubeka engotini. Ngako uyakukhokhela. Bonkhe busuku.

I-financing (letinye tindzawo tiyibita ngekutsi yi-swap, nobe imali yasebusuku) ikhokhiswa malanga onkhe, futsi nayi incenye lebamba wonkhe umuntfu: ikhokhiswa kuso SONKHE sikhundla, hhayi encenyeni lowayiboleka. Beka 500 NT kute ulawule 2,000 NT futsi ukhokha irenti ku-2,000.

Ibalwa njani: lizinga lenzalo lelisisekelo, kuhlanganiswe nenzuzo yemhlinzeki, kuhlukaniswe nga-365, kuphindzwe ngesikhundla sakho sonkhe. Ubona tingcenye totimbili esikrinini kulolu-app, ngoba imali longeke uyehlukanise yimali longeke uyehlulele. Cishe nge-7.3% ngemnyaka, loko kufika cishe ku-0.02% wesikhundla sakho ngebusuku.

Kuvakala shengatsi akusilutfo. Manje buka kutsi kudla njani kuhweba lokuwinako. 🧾

KUHWEBA LOKULUNGISAKO KODVWA USALAHLEKELWE

Uvula sikhundla se-2,000 NT ku-{retail} ngediphozithi ye-500 NT. Ulindzele kukhuphuka, futsi kugcina kutsi ulungile: etinyangeni letimbalwa letilandzelako i-{retail} ikhuphuka kancane nge-2%.

• Inzuzo yakho: 2% ye-2,000 = 40 NT. Ediphozithini ye-500 NT loko kungu-+8%. Kuhle.
• Irenti yakho: 0.02% ye-2,000 = 0.40 NT, bonkhe busuku.

Busuku 50: sewukhokhe 20 NT. Uphetulu ngu-20 NT sekukonkhe. Usawina.
Busuku 100: sewukhokhe 40 NT. Inzuzo yakho ye-40 NT manje ibita zero ncamashi. Ubone kahle kodvwa kute lowakutfolile.
Busuku 180: sewukhokhe 72 NT. Inzuzo yakho isese-40 NT. Uphansi ngu-32 NT, lokungukususa 6.4% wediphozithi yakho, ekuhwebeni lapho wafundza khona imakethe kahle tinyanga letisitfupha.

Phindza ukufundze loko. Intsengo yenta loko lowatsi itakwenta. Usalahlekelwe nobe kunjalo.

Lowo ngumusho lokufanele uwutsatse kulesifundvo: esikhundleni lesine-leverage, kulunga kunelilanga lekuphelelwa sikhatsi. Kulesibonelo ebusuku labangu-100, futsi ungakubala lokwakho ngaphambi kwekutsi uvule. Hlukanisa inzuzo lowetsemba kuyitfola ngerenti yasebusuku. Bobunyenti bebusuku lobubitwa ngumbono wakho.

Lokuphambene nako kufanele kunakwe. Lonkhe lolu-app lufundzisa nge-compounding, lapho sikhatsi sikwentela imali ngekuthula ulele. Lena ngumshini lofanako, usebenta ngemuva, ukhombe wena. ⏳

quiz.q: Ugcine sikhundla lesine-leverage se-2,000 NT lesikubita 0.40 NT ngebusuku nge-financing. Intsengo ikhuphuka ngalokwanele kukunika inzuzo ye-40 NT, bese iyama kunyakatfa. Ngemuva kwebusuku labangaki leyo nzuzo idliwe ngalokuphelele?
options: Ayikaze idliwe, ngoba i-financing ikhokhiswa encenyeni lebolekiwe kuphela
Cishe busuku labangu-100, ngoba 40 NT yenzuzo ihlukaniswe nga-0.40 NT ngebusuku ngu-100
Cishe busuku labangu-20, ngoba i-financing ikhokhiswa ediphozithini yakho ye-500 NT
I-financing ikhokhiswa kuphela nangabe sikhundla sivalwa ngekulahlekelwa

73.title: Ema-Future: Liwashi Nekuchubekisela (Roll)
73.content:
Ema-future nema-CFD bazala. Kokubili kune-leverage, kokubili kusebentisa i-margin, kokubili kungakwenta i-liquidation. Tintfo letimbili tenta ema-future ehluke, futsi lesesibili sinemdlandla.

⏰ 1. KUNELUSUKU KUWO. Sivumelwano ngasinye se-future siyaphelelwa sikhatsi. Emafutsa aMashi, umbila waJuni, i-index yaSeptemba. Nangabe lusuku lufika sivumelwano siyaphela futsi siyeke kuba khona. "Gcina ulindze kutsi ibuye" imane ingekho kuloko lokukhona, ngoba sivumelwano ngeke sibe khona. I-CFD ayikaze iphelelwe sikhatsi, lokuvakala kungcono kuze ukhumbule kutsi ikhokhisa irenti phakadze.

🔄 2. TINDLEKO TAKHIWE NGEKHATSI KWENTSENGO, ATIKHOKHISWA EBUSUKU. Le yincenye bantfu labayiphutsako. I-future ngalokuvamile ayikukhokhisi imali ye-financing yasebusuku. Esikhundleni saloko, tindleko tekugcina intfo kuze kufike lelo langa setivele tibhakwe entsengweni yesivumelwano. Tivumelwano telusuku lolusembili tivame kubita kakhulu kunetivumelwano telusuku lolusedvute, futsi lesikhala tindleko letifanako tekugcina, letihlala ngekhatsi kwenombolo.

Ngako kwentekani nangabe umhwebi afuna kugcina sikhundla ngale kwekuphelelwa sikhatsi? Uyakuchubekisela (ROLL): uvala sivumelwano lesiphelelwa sikhatsi, uvule lesilandzelako. Futsi nangabe lesilandzelako sibita kakhulu, ukhokha lowo mehluko. Kuko konkhe kuchubekisela. Leyo yirenti yasebusuku ye-CFD, letsatfwa ngetinkhokhelo letinkhulu, letingavamile.

Sifinyeto leliciniso:

• I-CFD: kute lilanga lekugcina, irenti bonkhe busuku, lebhalwe ngalokucacile esitatimendeni sakho.
• I-future: lilanga lekugcina leliqinile, tindleko tifihlwe entsengweni futsi tikhokhwa ekuchubekiseleni ngakunye, kulula kutiphutsa.

Kute lokumahhala. Lokunye kumane kwetfule likhokho ngenhlonipho lenkhulu, futsi tindleko longeke utibone tiyo letingakumangalisa kakhulu. ⏳

quiz.q: Umhwebi ufuna kugcina sikhundla se-future ngale kwelusuku lwaso lwekuphelelwa sikhatsi, futsi sivumelwano lesilandzelako sihwetjwa ngentsengo lephakeme kunalesiphelelwa sikhatsi. Kwentekani nangabe achubekisela?
quiz.explanation: Kuchubekisela kusho kuvala sivumelwano lesesitophelelwa sikhatsi nekuvula lesilandzelako. Nangabe lesilandzelako sibita kakhulu, unikela ngalowo mehluko, futsi ukwenta futsi kuko konkhe kuchubekisela. Tindleko tekugcina letifanako i-CFD letikukhokhisa tona bonkhe busuku, letitsatfwa ngetingcezu letinkhulu futsi tifihlwe entsengweni esikhundleni sekubhalwa esitatimendeni sakho.
options: Bakhokha sikhala emkhatsini wesivumelwano lesiphelelwa sikhatsi nalesilandzelako
Bakhokhelwa sikhala emkhatsini wetintsengo tetivumelwano letimbili
Kute imali leshintja tandla, ngoba kuchubekisela kuhweba kunye
Sikhundla siba yi-CFD sichubeke singenalo lusuku lwekuphelelwa sikhatsi

74.title: Kuhamba Kushort: Kulahlekelwa Lokungenaphansi
74.content:
Konkhe kulolu-app kuze kube manje bekuyi-long: uyatsenga, ufuna kutsi intsengo ikhuphuke. Ema-derivative akuvumela kutsi uhambe ushort (short), lokusho kubheja kutsi intsengo iyehla. Uvula i-short, intsengo iyehla, uyazuza.

Kushort kuyasita ngempela futsi akusiko kubi. Yindlela umlimi lagcina ngayo intsengo ngaphambi kwekuvuna nendlela sikhwama lesivikela ngayo iphothifoliyo. Kukuvisisa kukwenta ube ncono ekufundzeni emakethe, ngoba kwekucala ungabona tinhlangotsi totimbili takho konkhe kuhweba.

Kodvwa kukhona lucezu lunye lwetibalo ekushorteni lolungenalo lolufanako kunobe kuphi lokunye, futsi udzinga kutsi lubhalwe engcondvweni yakho.

📉 NAWUTSENGA, lokubi kakhulu kutsi intsengo iye ku-zero. Ulahlekelwa yi-100% yaloko lowakufaka. Kubi kakhulu, kodvwa liphansi. Kunaphansi.
📈 NAWUSHORTA, intsengo ihamba iphambene nawe kusho kutsi intsengo IYAKHUPHUKA. Futsi kute umtsetfo kunobe kuphi lotsi intsengo ivumelekile kukhuphuka kangakanani. Lisheya leliphindzeka katsatfu likubita 200% wesikhundla. Lisheya lelikhuphuka kalishumi likubita 900%.

Kulahlekelwa kwe-long kunaphansi. Kulahlekelwa kwe-short akunalo. Lokungalingani kuyisecwayiso sonkhe.

Emakethe angempela ayakwenta loku. Ngaletinye tikhatsi lisheya lelishortwe kakhulu liyachuma, ngoba wonkhe umuntfu loshortile uphocelelwa kutsenga kute avale, lokusunduta intsengo etulu, lokuphocelela labanyenti kutsenga. Kubitwa ngekutsi yi-short squeeze futsi seyake yacedza tikhwama.

Tintfo letimbili tikugcina uphila. Kwekucala, i-short ngiyo ncamashi lapho i-stop-loss iyeka khona kuba yintfo yekutikhetsela. Kwesibili, kuvikelwa kwebhalansi lengaphansi kwe-zero: ku-akhawunti lelawulwa kahle yemtsengi lojwayelekile, nakulolu-app, i-akhawunti yakho ingeke yehle ngaphansi kwe-zero. Ungalahlekelwa ngiko konkhe lokufakile. Ungeke ugcine ukweleta imali. Lokuvikelwa kukhona ngoba, ngaphambi kwako, bantfu bebakweleta. 🕳️

quiz.q: Kungani lokubi kakhulu esikhundleni se-short kwehlukile ngebunjalo kunalokubi kakhulu esikhundleni se-long?
quiz.explanation: Kutsenga kunaphansi. Lokubi kakhulu intsengo lengakwenta kufika ku-zero, ngako ulahlekelwa ngiloko lokufakile kuphela. Kushorta kuphambene, ngoba kulahlekelwa kusho kutsi intsengo iyakhuphuka, futsi kute lokutsi intsengo ingakhuphuka kangakanani. Lisheya leliphindzeka katsatfu libita loshortako kuphindza kabili sikhundla. Ngiko nje i-stop iyeka kuba yintfo yekutikhetsela ku-short, futsi ngiko nje lolu-app lungeke lukwehlisele ngaphansi kwe-zero.

Kwehla kuhamba kancane kunekukhuphuka, ngako i-short ilahlekelwa kancane
Intsengo ingehlela ku-zero kuphela, kodvwa ingakhuphuka ngaphandle kwemkhawulo

75.title: Kugucuka Kwemanani Kuphindzwe nge-Leverage
75.desc: Kungani ikhripto idzinga idiphozithi lenkhulu kakhulu lapha
75.content:
Siphindzi lesifanako etintfweni letimbili letehlukene akusiko kubheja lokufanako. Lowo ngumcondvo wonkhe walesifundvo, futsi yikho lokwenta idiphozithi lokufanele uyibeke ishintje kuye ngekutsi uhweba ngani.

Cabanga kutsi lilanga lelijwayelekile libukeka njani:
• I-index lenkhulu inyakatfa ngaphansi kwe-1% emalangeni lamanyenti.
• Lisheya linye linganyakatfa nga-2% nobe 3%.
• Ikhripto ivame kunyakatfa nga-5% nobe 10%, futsi lilanga le-20% akusiyo inhlekelele, nguLesibili nje. 🎢

Manje beka idiphozithi lencane ngemuva kwaletintfo ngayinye. Ngediphozithi ye-10%, kunyakatfa kwe-10% kuyakucedza. Ku-index, leso sehlakalo sekwenteka kanye eminyakeni lemibili. Ekhriptweni cishe kwenteka nyanga yonkhe. Idiphozithi lefanako. Emathuba ekusinda lehlukene ngalokuphelele.

Balawuli bakubona loku bakubhala emitsetfweni. Ngesikhatsi i-ESMA ibeka umkhawulo we-leverage ye-CFD kulo lonkhe le-Europe ngaMashi 2018, ayizange ikhetse inombolo yinye. Yatehlukanisa ngemazinga: 30:1 kumabhangca lamakhulu emali, 20:1 egolideni nakuma-index lamakhulu, 10:1 kulamanye emakhomodithi, 5:1 emasheyeni lawodvwa, futsi phansi khona, 2:1 ekhriptweni. Kubili kulokunye kusho idiphozithi ye-50%. Ekhriptweni bafuna INGCENYE yesikhundla ngemali yangempela, lizinga lelicinile kakhulu kulo lonkhe luhlu.

Lolu-app lwenta intfo lefanako, ngesizatfu lesifanako, futsi lusho njalo esikrinini esikhundleni sekukufihla:

💱 I-Forex: idiphozithi lencane kakhulu, ngoba emabhangca lamakhulu anyakatfa kancane.
🥇 Igolide nemakhomodithi: lenkhulu.
📊 Emasheya, ema-index nema-ETF: lenkhulu futsi.
🪙 Ikhripto: idiphozithi lenkhulu kakhulu kunato tonkhe, ngoba ikhripto inyakatfa kakhulu.

Ikhripto ayivinjelwanga lapha, futsi loko kwentiwe ngenhloso. Ungahweba ngayo. Umane ungeke uhwebe ngayo ngediphozithi lencane, ngoba ngediphozithi lencane lilanga lelijwayelekile lekhripto belingacedza i-akhawunti yakho ngaphambi kwekutsi uceda kufundza ngako. Idiphozithi lenkhulu akusilo lu-app ludlala ngekhripto. Lu-app luciniseka kutsi lilanga lelijwayelekile ngeke likubulale.

Kufanele kwatiwe: umlawuli wase-UK wendlula lizinga. Nga-2021 wavimbela ema-derivative ekhripto kubatsengi labajwayelekile ngalokuphelele, alinganisela kutsi labatsengi batawonga cishe tigidzi te-£53. Ungahlangabetana ne-leverage yekhripto lapha, ngemali lengesiyo yangempela nediphozithi lekhuluphele, nobe ungahlangabetana nayo uneminyaka lelishumi nesishiyagalombili ngemali yangempela ngaphandle kwesecwayiso nhlobo. Lona ngulohlelo lolungcono. 🌡️

quiz.q: Ikhripto idzinga idiphozithi lenkhulu kakhulu kunanobe ngumuphi umphahla kulelikamelo. Ngusiphi sizatfu sangempela?
quiz.explanation: I-index lenkhulu inyakatfa ngaphansi kwe-1% emalangeni lamanyenti. Ikhripto ivame kunyakatfa nga-5% nobe 10%, futsi lilanga le-20% akusiyo inhlekelele, nguLesibili nje. Ngediphozithi lencane, kunyakatfa kwe-10% kuyakucedza, lokusehlakalo sekwenteka kanye eminyakeni lemibili ku-index futsi cishe nyanga yonkhe ekhriptweni. Umlawuli we-Europe wafuna ingcenye yesikhundla ngemali yangempela ekhriptweni, lizinga lelicinile kakhulu kulo lonkhe luhlu lwakhe, ngalesizatfu ncamashi.
options: Labangaphansi kwemnyaka we-18 bavinjelwe ekhriptweni, ngako idiphozithi yinhlawulo
Kute i-financing lekhokhiswa ekhriptweni, ngako idiphozithi iyayingena esikhundleni
Inyakatfa kakhulu, ngako lilanga lelijwayelekile lingacedza idiphozithi lencane
Lu-app lubeka emanani ekhripto ngekwalo esikhundleni sekutsi kwentiwe yimakethe

76.title: Tinombolo Kute Loticwayisako
76.content:
Awusoze uyibona letinombolo ku-advert. Tivela kubalawuli betetimali, labangafuna idatha yangempela yema-akhawunti etinkampanini, bese bashicilela loko labakutfolile.

🇪🇺 I-ESMA, umlawuli we-Europe, Mashi 2018. Emaveni e-EU, emkhatsini we-74% na-89% wema-akhawunti e-CFD ebatsengi labajwayelekile alahlekelwa yimali. Kulahlekelwa lokulinganiselwe ngelikhasimende ngalinye bekusukela ku-€1,600 kuya ku-€29,000. I-ESMA yawuncabela lomkhicito ngenca yaloko.

🇬🇧 I-FCA e-UK, Disemba 2016. Kuhlatiya kwayo sampula lemele ema-akhawunti emakhasimende kwatfola kutsi 82% wemakhasimende walahlekelwa yimali kulemikhicito.

🇦🇺 I-ASIC e-Australia, leshicilelwe ngaJanuwari 2026, lensha kakhulu kuletintsatfu. Emnyakeni wetetimali wa-2024, 68% wabatjalimali be-CFD labajwayelekile balahlekelwa yimali, lokuhlanganiswe kwaba ngetulu kwetigidzi te-A$458. Kuloko, tigidzi te-A$73 bekutimali tetinsita.

Hlala nalowo mugca wekugcina umzuzwana. Tigidzi letingemashumi lasikhombisa nakutsatfu akusiko ngisho kuhweba lokubi. Bekutindleko tekudlala: i-spread nawungena, ne-financing lowayihlangabetana nayo esifundvweni 72.

Balawuli labatsatfu labehlukene, emave lamatsatfu lehlukene, idatha lehlanganisa emashumi eminyaka lamatsatfu lehlukene, futsi imphendvulo ichubeka iwela emkhatsini wetingcenye letimbili kulokutsatfu netingcenye letiyimfica kulokulishumi.

Manje incenye lebaluleke kakhulu, ngoba ngiyo levimba loku kutsi kube yinombolo yekwesabisa. Labo bantfu bebangesibo tilima. Bebangesibo ematfuba. Bebakakhulu bantfu labadzala labanemisebenti, futsi labanyenti babo bebafundza lishadi kancono kunawe njenganyalo. Balahlekelwa ngenca yendlela lomkhicito lowakhiwe ngayo: ucala usemuva ngenca ye-spread, ukhokha irenti ngesikhatsi ulindza, futsi i-leverage isho kutsi kunyakatfa lokujwayelekile kungakucedza ngaphambi kwekutsi umbono wakho ube nesikhatsi sekulunga.

Leso sakhiwo, akusilo liphutsa lebuntfu. Futsi tinhlaka tingehlulwa kuphela ngulabo labati kutsi tikhona. 📊

quiz.explanation: Labo bekubantfu labadzala labajwayelekile labanemisebenti, futsi labanyenti babo bebafundza lishadi kancono kunawe namuhla. Balahlekelwa ngenca yendlela lomkhicito lowusebenta ngayo: ucala usemuva ngenca ye-spread, ukhokha irenti bonkhe busuku ngesikhatsi ulindza, futsi i-leverage isho kutsi kunyakatfa lokujwayelekile kungakucedza ngaphambi kwekutsi umbono wakho ube nesikhatsi sekulunga. Leso sakhiwo, akusilo liphutsa lebuntfu, futsi tinhlaka tingehlulwa ngulabo labati kutsi tikhona.
options: Indlela lomkhicito lowakhiwe ngayo isebenta iphambene nelikhasimende
Bantfu labalahlekelwa bebanganaki, futsi bahwebi labanakekelako bayaphila
Tinkampani letincintisanako tashicilela letinombolo njengekuhlasela kwekukhangisa

77.title: Loko Lokwashintja Nangabe Imitsetfo Ishintja
77.content:
Sifundvo 76 sakunika kulahlekelwa. Lesifundvo sikunika luhlolo, futsi yintfo lebaluleke kakhulu kulesigaba.

Nangabe bantfu labanyenti balahlekelwa ngoba bantfu labanyenti abanaki, kushintja imitsetfo bekungeke kushintje lutfo. Labanganaki bahlala banganaki. Akunjalo?

I-Australia yenta luhlolo. NgaMashi 2021 i-ASIC yaphocelela tivikelo kuto tonkhe tinkampani te-CFD letisebentela emakhasimende lajwayelekile: imikhawulo ye-leverage, umtsetfo lojwayelekile wekuvala ngekutentakalela, kuvikelwa kwebhalansi lengaphansi kwe-zero, nekuvinjelwa kwetinkhutsato letifana nemabhonasi ekubhalisa. Emakhasimende lafanako. Tinkampani letifanako. Emakethe lafanako. Imitsetfo kuphela leyashintja.

Naku loko i-ASIC lekulinganisile etinyangeni letisitfupha tekucala. 🔬

📉 Kulahlekelwa lokuphelele kwema-akhawunti ebatsengi labajwayelekile kwehla nge-91%, kusuka esilinganisweni setigidzi te-A$372 ngelikota kuya etigidzini te-A$33.
📉 Ema-akhawunti lalahlekelwako ebatsengi labajwayelekile ehla nge-51% ngelikota.
📉 Kuvalwa kwe-margin kwehla nge-87%.
📉 Tehlakalo tebhalansi lengaphansi kwe-zero tehla nge-88%.

Kute loba ngulohlakaniphe kakhulu etinyangeni letisitfupha. Umklamo washintja, futsi tingcenye letiyimfica kulokulishumi temonakalo tanyamalala nawo.

Tintfo letimbili tiyalandzela, futsi kufanele utitfwale totimbili.

Kwekucala: nawulahlekelwa ekuhwebeni lokune-leverage, lokunyenti kwaloko lokwenteka kuwe bekwakhiwe emkhicitweni ngaphambi kwekutsi ufike. Loko akusiyo imvume yekungabi nendaba. Kusizatfu sekuyihlonipha lentfo.

Kwesibili, futsi le yincenye lewusito: tivikelo letenta umsebenti ngiyo ncamashi imikhuba lesigaba lebesesikufundzisa yona. Sikhundla lesincane. Kuphuma ngekutentakalela. Liphansi leliqinile emonakalweni. Umlawuli kwadzingeka kutsi aphocelele loko kuyo yonkhe imboni kute atfole leyo 91%. Wena ungamane ukukhetse. 🛡️

quiz.explanation: Emakhasimende lafanako, tinkampani letifanako, emakethe lafanako. Imitsetfo kuphela leyashintja, futsi tingcenye letiyimfica kulokulishumi temonakalo tahamba nayo. Kute loba ngulohlakaniphe kakhulu etinyangeni letisitfupha. Tivikelo letenta umsebenti yimikhuba lesigaba lesichubeka sikufundzisa yona: sikhundla lesincane, kuphuma ngekutentakalela, neliphansi leliqinile ngaphansi kwemonakalo. Umlawuli kwadzingeka aphocelele loko kuyo yonkhe imboni. Wena ungamane ukukhetse.

78.title: Sikhala Lesigcuma I-Stop Yakho
78.desc: I-stop ngumyalo wekuhamba, hhayi intsengo letsenjisiwe
78.content:
Sewuhlangabetane nema-stop-loss esifundvweni 19. Naku loko i-leverage lekwenta kuwo.

I-stop-loss ngumyalo: "nangabe intsengo ifika kulelizinga, ngikhiphe." Akusiso sivumelwano mayelana nentsengo lotawuyitfola. Itsi hamba. Ayisho kutsi hamba khona lapha ncamashi.

Tikhatsi letinyenti lomehluko awubalulekanga, ngoba emanani anyakatfa ngetinyatselo letincane futsi i-oda yakho igcwaliswa eduze nelizinga lakho. Bese ngaletinye tikhatsi ubaluleke kakhulu.

📰 Emakethe ayavala. Tindzaba tifika nga-11pm. Imakethe ivula kabusha iphansi nge-8% kunalapho ivale khona, futsi ayizange ihwebe kunobe nguyiphi intsengo lesemkhatsini. I-stop yakho beyikulesosikhala. Iyasebenta ekuvuleni kabusha futsi igcwaliswa nobe kuphi lapho imakethe ikhona ngempela, lokungale kakhulu kwelizinga lolikhetsile.

Ngaphandle kwe-leverage, loko lilanga lelibi. Nge-leverage, kungaba yi-akhawunti yonkhe, ngoba nangabe idiphozithi yakho beyincane kunesikhala, sikhala sidlula ngco entsengweni yakho ye-liquidation, futsi uvalwa ngaphansi kwelizinga injini lebeyilihlosile.

Tintfo letintsatfu longatenta ngaloku, kute nalinye lelilukhuni:

1️⃣ Ungayitsatsi i-stop njengesicinisekiso. Yitsatse njengemkhuba lomuhle kakhulu lonebutsakatsaka bunye lobatiwako.
2️⃣ Yati kutsi imakethe yakho ivalwa nini nekutsi yini lehleliwe. Imiphumela yetinkampani, tincumo telizinga lenzalo kanye nekhetfo tikhala letibhalwe kudayari.
3️⃣ Lungisa bukhulu kute sikhala singakucedzi. Loku kutivikela kwangempela, futsi kusifundvo lesilandzelako. I-stop ikuvikela kulokujwayelekile. Bukhulu besikhundla bukuvikela kulokungajwayelekile, futsi lokungajwayelekile ngiko lokucedza bantfu ngempela.

Futsi kufanele kwatiwe kutsi kulolu-app, njengakunobe nguyiphi i-akhawunti lelawulwa kahle yemtsengi lojwayelekile, kuvikelwa kwebhalansi lengaphansi kwe-zero kusho kutsi sikhala singeke sikwehlisele ngaphansi kwe-zero. Ungalahlekelwa yi-akhawunti. Ungeke ugcine ukweleta. 📰

quiz.q: Ubeka i-stop-loss ku-{c}90. Ebusuku, tindzaba letimbi tiyafika futsi imakethe ivula kabusha ku-{c}78, ingakaze ihwebe emkhatsini. Kwentekani?
quiz.explanation: I-stop ngumyalo wekuhamba, akusiso setsembiso mayelana nentsengo loyitfolako. Imakethe ayizange ihwebe emkhatsini we-{c}90 ne-{c}78, ngako bekungasekho {c}90 yekutsengisa ngayo. I-stop yakho iyasebenta ekuvuleni kabusha futsi igcwaliswa nobe kuphi lapho imakethe ikhona ngempela. Ema-stop asakuvikela ekunyakatfeni lokujwayelekile. Kutivikela ekugcumeni lokunjengalokhu bukhulu besikhundla, hhayi i-stop.
options: I-stop yakho igcwaliswa ku-{c}90, ncamashi lapho uyibeke khona
Ugcwaliswa eduze ne-{c}78, intsengo yekucala lekhona
I-oda iyakhanselwa, ngoba intsengo yaleyecela

79.title: Bukhulu Kucala, Bese Kuba Kuhweba
79.desc: Nca loko longakulahlekelwa ngaphambi kwekutsi unce loko lotakutsenga
79.content:
Nayi intfo lehlukanisa bantfu labaphilako kulabangaphili, futsi cishe iyisicefe.

Bacalisi bakhetsa kuhweba, bese babala kutsi bafake malini. Bachwepheshe bakwenta ngalokuphambene. Banca kucala kutsi bavuma kulahlekelwa yini, bese bavumela loko kutsi kunce kutsi sikhundla sivumelekile kuba sikhulu kangakanani.

Umtsetfo labanyenti babo labawusebentisako: beka engotini 1% kuya ku-2% we-akhawunti kunobe nguku kuhweba lokukodvwa. Hhayi idiphozithi ye-1%. INGOTI ye-1%, lokusho kutsi loko ngiko lotakulahlekelwa ngempela nangabe i-stop yakho ishaywa.

Kusebenta njani, ngetinyatselo letintsatfu:

1️⃣ Khetsa kulahlekelwa kwakho lokukhulu kakhulu. I-akhawunti ye-10,000 NT, ubeka engotini 1%, ngako 100 NT.
2️⃣ Khetsa lapho ungalungi khona. Utawuphuma nangabe intsengo yehla nge-5% kusuka lapho ungene khona.
3️⃣ Hlukanisa. 100 NT yekulahlekelwa lokwemukelekako, ebangeni le-stop le-5%, kusho sikhundla se-2,000 NT. Lobo bukhulu bakho. Hhayi umuva. Kubala.

Shintja i-stop futsi bukhulu buyashintja ngekutentakalela. I-stop leciniwe ye-2% ikuvumela kutsi usebentise 5,000 NT. I-stop lebanti ye-10% ikuphocelela kwehlela ku-1,000 NT. Nangabe kuhweba kunengoti lenkhulu, kufanele kube kuncane, futsi tibalo tikwentela loko kute imiva yakho ingadzingi kukwenta.

Kungani 1%? Ngoba kwenta kulandzelana kwekulahlekelwa kusindzeke. Kulahlekelwa lokulishumi kulandzelana nge-1% kukushiya ne-90% we-akhawunti yakho nemiva lemibi. Kulahlekelwa lokulishumi kulandzelana nge-20% kukushiya ne-11% we-akhawunti yakho futsi ungenayo indlela yekubuya, futsi sewuvele wati esifundvweni 71 kutsi kukhuphuka loko kubhekise etulu kangakanani.

Kute losinda emakethe ngekukhetsa labawinako. Wonkhe umuntfu losindako ukwenta ngekuciniseka kutsi kute kulahlekelwa lokukodvwa lokungamcedza. 📐

quiz.q: I-akhawunti ye-10,000 NT. Utawubeka engotini 1% kulokuhweba, futsi utawuphuma nangabe intsengo yehla nge-5% kusuka lapho ungene khona. Dvonsa uye ebukhulwini besikhundla lobuhlonipha loko.
quiz.explanation: I-1% ye-10,000 NT ngu-100 NT, futsi loko ngiko lokukhulu kakhulu lowavuma kukulahlekelwa. I-stop ye-5% isho 100 NT ihlukaniswe nge-5%, lokusikhundla se-2,000 NT. Dvonsa uye etulu futsi sibonisi sikukhombisa ubeka engotini kwendlula loko lowakuncumile.

80.title: Kungani Kuwina Kutiva Shengatsi Likhono
80.content:
I-leverage akusiyo inkinga yetibalo kakhulu. Tibalo tilula. Yinkinga yengcondvo, futsi nati letintsatfu letibamba wonkhe umuntfu.

🎯 1. KUBANDLULULA NGEMPHUMELA (OUTCOME BIAS): kuwina kutiva shengatsi likhono. Utsatsa sikhundla lesikhulu ngalokwedlulele, siyasebenta, wenta lokunyenti ngentsambama yinye, futsi ingcondvo yakho ibhala phansi kutsi "ngikhaliphile kuloku." Ayizange ibhale loko lokwenteka ngempela, lokukutsi watsatsa ingoti lembi wase utfola umphumela lomuhle. Leto tintfo letehlukene, futsi imakethe itawujabula kukukhokhela ngesincumo lesibi tikhatsi letimbalwa ngaphambi kwekutsi icoce. Intfo leyingoti kakhulu lengenteka kumhwebi lomusha kuwina kusenesikhatsi, lokulula.

😤 2. KUHWEBA KWEKUPHINDZISELA: ufuna kuyibuyisa, manje. Ulahlekelwa, kuyahlaba, futsi sifiso sivela masinyane. Ngako ukhulisa sikhundla. Manje ufaka sikhundla sakho lesikhulu kakhulu ngumzuzu ncamashi lapho kwehlulela kwakho kusezingeni lelibi kakhulu, ekuhwebeni lokukhetse ngoba bewutfukutsele kunekutsi bekukuhle. Imakethe ayati kutsi wehlile futsi ayikakweleti lutfo. Nawutiva njena, bukhulu lobulungile ngu-zero. Vala lu-app.

🕳️ 3. KUJAHA KULAHLEKELWA: "Ngitawumane ngigcine kuze ibuye." Loku kugcoke njengesineke, ngiko nje kulukhuni kakhulu kukubona. Sineke luhlelo lowalwenta ngekuthula kusenesikhatsi. Kujaha luhlelo lowalusungula ngemuva kwekutsi intsengo ihambe iphambene nawe, futsi luphawu lulula: kuphuma kwakho kwasuka. Nangabe utitfola uchaza kutsi kungani lizinga lowalibeka lingaseselo lelilungile, loko akusiko kuhlatiya lokusha. Loko kutigcabha kwakho kuyaxoxisana.

Kutivikela kuto tontsatfu kuyafana futsi akunabuhle. Nca konkhe nawusenekuthula, kubhale phansi, futsi uphatse lomunye wena lovela ekhatsi nekuhweba njengemlandzisi longetsembeki. 🧠

Kuwina kusenesikhatsi, lokulula yintfo leyingoti kakhulu lengenteka kumhwebi lomusha, ngoba kufundzisa sifundvo lesingakalungi bese kukukhokhisa ngaso ngemuva.

81.title: Umbuto Leliciniso
81.content:
Usicedzile lesigaba. Nangu umbuto ema-advert langakaze awubute.

Kufanele uyisebentise yini i-leverage nhlobo?

Kubantfu labanyenti, tikhatsi letinyenti, imphendvulo leliciniso ngutsi cha. Hhayi ngoba bangakahlakaniphi ngalokwanele. Ngenca yako konkhe kuletifundvo letilishumi nesihlanu letendlulile: ucala usemuva, ukhokha irenti ngesikhatsi ulindza, kunyakatfa lokujwayelekile kungakucedza ngaphambi kwekutsi kufakazelwe kutsi ulungile, futsi balawuli labatsatfu lababala ema-akhawunti langempela bachubeka batfola kutsi tingcenye letimbili kulokutsatfu kuya etingcenyeni letiyimfica kulokulishumi tebantfu talahlekelwa.

Kunendlela yekuhweba lapho ungakaze utsintse lutfo kuloku. Utsenga lisheya, uba nencenye yenkampani, tinzuzo temasheya tiyafika, sikhatsi sisebenta SINGAKUWE esikhundleni sekukuphikisa, futsi kute lokungavala sikhundla sakho ngaphandle kwekubuta. Lolo lonkhe lolu-app, futsi akusiyo indlela lenesicefe. Yindlela tibalo tesifundvo 14 letitsi ngalokuvamile iyawina. 🌱

Ngako nakhu lokufanele ukwati ngaphambi kwekutsi unce.

Kute lokukhiywe ngemuva kwe-leverage kulolu-app. Wonkhe umncintiswano, onkhe emabhodi ebaholi, yonkhe indlela ye-XP, wonkhe umdlalo wesikolwa nawo wonkhe umvuzo we-NOOB kuhlala kuvulekile ngalokuphelele kumuntfu longakaze avule ngisho sikhundla sinye lesine-leverage. Awulahlekelwa lutfo ngekusuka kulelikamelo. Kute inhlawulo futsi kute libheji lelilahlekile.

Futsi kute lokulapha lokukukhokhela ngekuwina. Uyavuzwa ngekucedza tifundvo, ngekuphasa luhlolo, ngekubeka i-stop, ngekuvala lokulahlekelwako, nangekubhala nge-liquidation yakho. Awukaze ukhokhelwe ngenzuzo, ngesikhundla lesikhulu nobe ngenhlanhla lelandzelanako, ngoba kukukhokhela ngaloko bekutawuba kukufundzisa intfo lengakalungi kube kubitwa ngekutsi yimfundvo.

Nangabe uyayisebentisa: yisebentise kancane, yisebentise ne-stop, yati intsengo yakho ye-liquidation ngaphambi kwekutsi ucindzetele lutfo, futsi ungalokotsi ngemali bewungayikhumbula. Nangabe ungayisebentisi, usafundze kubona umshini, lokwakuyinhloso njalo. Bantfu labadzala labanyenti labahweba ngaletintfo abakwati kuchaza loko losandza kukufundza. 🤔

Kute inhlawulo futsi kute libheji lelilahlekile. Futsi kute lokulelikamelo lokukukhokhela ngekuwina: kukhokhela kucedza tifundvo, kuphasa luhlolo, kubeka i-stop nekuvala lokulahlekelwako.

84.title: Lokubi Kakhulu Kwakho, Lokukhetswe Kusenesikhatsi
84.content:
Uyayati idiphozithi, i-call, kuvala, irenti, i-stop nesikhala. Lesifundvo sibeka lucezu lwekugcina endzaweni yalo: sonkhe sikhundla lotawuke usivule siphela ngendlela yinye ncamashi kuletintsatfu, futsi umdlalo wonkhe ngukutsi ngubani lokhetsa leyiphi.

1️⃣ UYASIVALA WENA. Utsintsa inkinobho bese sikhundla sivalwa ngentsengo yemakethe yamanje. Kuhlala kukhona, kuso sonkhe sikhundla, kuso sonkhe simo. Kuphuma lokunyenti kufanele kube nguloku.

2️⃣ I-ODA LOYIBEKILE IYASIVALA. Tinhlobo letimbili, futsi emagama abalulekile, ngako wafundze kahle:

• I-ODA YE-STOP-LOSS ikuvala ngekutentakalela nangabe intsengo inyakatfa IPHAMBENE nawe iya ezingeni lolikhetsile: i-sell-stop ngaphansi kwalapho ungene khona ku-long, i-buy-stop ngetulu kwalapho ungene khona ku-short. Lokubi kakhulu kwakho, lokuncunywe nawusenekuthula, lesifundvo 80 lesesikufundzisile kutsi ngiso sikhatsi lesisodvwa lapho unca khona nobe yini kahle.
• I-ODA YE-TAKE-PROFIT yi-limit order yekuvala: ikuvala ngekutentakalela enhlosweni loyikhetsile, nangabe intsengo inyakatfa NGEKUSITA WENA kute ifike kuyo. Ngu-"kwanele" kwakho, lokuncunywe ngaphambi kwekutsi buhhaha bube nelivoti. I-limit order igcwaliswa ezingeni lakho nobe kuncono, akusoze kube kubi.

3️⃣ UMHLINZEKI UYASIVALA. Leyo yi-liquidation, esifundvweni 70. Futsi nayi intfo lokufanele uyibhale engcondvweni: i-liquidation akusiyo luhlobo lwe-oda. Angeke ubeke "kuhweba kwe-liquidation". Kute lokhonako. Akusilo lithulusi kulawakho; yintfo umhlinzeki layentako kute avikele sikweletu sakhe nangabe idiphozithi yakho cishe seyiphelile, nobe ngayiphi intsengo imakethe leyikhokhako, ngesikhatsi usesikolweni nobe ulele.

I-stop-loss nguwe unca lokubi kakhulu kwakho kusenesikhatsi. I-liquidation yiloko lokwentekako nangabe ungakwentanga.

Tonkhe ema-oda akho tetsembekile ngendlela lefanako, futsi sewuvele wati esifundvweni 78: asebenta ezingeni lakho futsi agcwaliswe ngaloko imakethe lekukhokhako ngempela. Sikhala lesedlula i-stop yakho sikugcwalisa ngale kwekugcuma, lokukubi kakhulu. Sikhala lesedlula i-take-profit yakho sikugcwalisa ngale nako, lokuncono. Liciniso lelifanako, libheke nhlangotsi totimbili.

Umtsetfo munye wekubeka, futsi lolu-app luyawuphocelela ngesizatfu esikrinini: i-stop yakho kufanele ibe emkhatsini wentsengo yamanje nentsengo yakho ye-liquidation. Eminyango lemitsatfu yekuphuma kuko konkhe kuhweba. Lemibili yayo inelibito lakho esibambo. Kuphuma ngalomunye wayo, ngelilanga lolikhetsile, ezingeni lolikhetse usenekuthula, ngiko lesigaba sonkhe lebesikufundzisa kukwenta. 🚪
